```rs
//! Synthetic fixtures shared by the ledger tests. Each test file uses a subset.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use quen_core::ledger::{BootEnd, BootStart, Capture, Game, Ledger, Measurement, Outcome, Tag};
use serde_json::Value;

/// A ledger path, `quen.db` in a folder of its own in the OS temp folder, unique per test. The folder (with the
/// ledger's backups) goes with it.
pub struct TempDb(pub PathBuf);

impl TempDb {
    pub fn new() -> TempDb {
        static N: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
        let nanos = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_nanos();
        let n = N.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "quen-ledger-test-{}-{nanos}-{n}",
            std::process::id()
        ));
        std::fs::create_dir(&dir).unwrap();
        TempDb(dir.join("quen.db"))
    }

    pub fn dir(&self) -> &Path {
        self.0.parent().unwrap()
    }
}

impl Drop for TempDb {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(self.dir());
    }
}

/// A synthetic sha256: `n` as 64 hex digits.
pub fn sha(n: u32) -> String {
    format!("{n:064x}")
}

pub fn game(l: &mut Ledger) -> i64 {
    l.add_game(&Game {
        name: "synthetic".into(),
        exe_path: r"%GAME_DIR%\bin\x64\game.exe".into(),
        exe_sha256: sha(1),
        build_stamp: Some("0x00000001".into()),
    })
    .unwrap()
}

/// A boot that started and ended at `t`.
pub fn boot(l: &mut Ledger, game: i64, t: &str) -> i64 {
    let id = l
        .start_boot(&BootStart {
            game_id: game,
            t_start: t.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .unwrap();
    l.finish_boot(
        id,
        &BootEnd {
            t_end: t.into(),
            outcome: Outcome::Ok,
            failure: None,
            patches: vec![],
        },
    )
    .unwrap();
    id
}

pub fn measurement(l: &mut Ledger, boot: Option<i64>, family: &str, tag: Tag) -> i64 {
    l.add_measurement(&Measurement {
        boot_id: boot,
        capture_id: None,
        metric: "frame_ms".into(),
        value: Some(23.2),
        unit: Some("ms".into()),
        state_label: Some("B".into()),
        method_family: family.into(),
        tag,
        run_id: Some("run-1".into()),
        note: None,
        extraction_id: None,
        world: None,
    })
    .unwrap()
}

pub fn capture(l: &mut Ledger, boot: Option<i64>, path: &str, t: &str) -> i64 {
    l.add_capture(&Capture {
        boot_id: boot,
        path: path.into(),
        sha256: sha(9),
        bytes: 1024,
        kind: "png".into(),
        t: t.into(),
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .unwrap()
}

/// The rows of a query that must succeed.
pub fn rows(l: &Ledger, sql: &str, params: &[Value]) -> Vec<Vec<Value>> {
    l.query(sql, params, Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap().rows
}

/// The build stamp of the synthetic KB's build line.
pub const STAMP: &str = "0x0BADF00D";

/// The commit the synthetic KB's work tree has checked out.
pub fn commit() -> String {
    "c".repeat(40)
}

/// A synthetic RE knowledge base for the build `exe_sha256` under `dir`: a git work tree `repo` (its `.git` only HEAD
/// and the branch's ref) with the KB at `repo/re`: names.tsv, hooks.tsv, patches.tsv, instance_patches.tsv and
/// cvar_layout.tsv, a note under `notes/` and a small frame map under `frame/`. Returns the KB root.
pub fn fake_kb(dir: &Path, exe_sha256: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let repo = dir.join("repo");
    let kb = repo.join("re");
    for sub in [".git/refs/heads", "re/notes", "re/frame"] {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(repo.join(sub)).unwrap();
    }
    std::fs::write(repo.join(".git/HEAD"), "ref: refs/heads/main\n").unwrap();
    std::fs::write(repo.join(".git/refs/heads/main"), format!("{}\n", commit())).unwrap();
    let line = format!("# build: sha256={exe_sha256} stamp={STAMP}\n");
    let files = [
        (
            "names.tsv",
            format!(
                "# synthetic names, not from any real binary\n{line}rva\tname\tkind\tconfidence\tsource\tdate\n\
                 0x1000\tAlpha_Draw\tfunction\tO\ttest\t2026-10-18\n\
                 0x2000\tBeta_Setup\tfunction\tI\ttest\t2026-10-18\n\
                 0x3000\t\tfunction\tO\ttest\t2026-10-18\n\
                 0x3010\tGamma_Table\tlabel\tO\ttest\t2026-10-18\n\
                 0x4000\t\tcode\tO\ttest\t2026-10-18\n"
            ),
        ),
        (
            "hooks.tsv",
            format!(
                "# synthetic sites\n{line}site\tkind\tmod\tversion\tnote\n\
                 0x1000\thook\tModA\t1.0\tdraw hook\n\
                 0x1234\tmid-hook\tModB\t2.0\tinside alpha\n"
            ),
        ),
        (
            "patches.tsv",
            format!("name\trva\told\tnew\tbuild\tboundaries-checked\ncull_off\t0x1F00\t74 05\teb 05\t{STAMP}\t-\n"),
        ),
        (
            "instance_patches.tsv",
            format!(
                "name\tclass\tvtable\tbuild\toffset\ttype\told\tnew\tboundaries-checked\n\
                 steer_wide\tCFake\t0x5000\t{STAMP}\t0x58\tf32\t0.2\t0.35\t-\n"
            ),
        ),
        (
            "cvar_layout.tsv",
            format!(
                "build\tgroup\tname\tflags\tvalue\tdefault\tlive\tbool\tint\tfloat\n\
                 {STAMP}\t0x08\t0x10\t0x18\t0x20\t0x28\t0x30\t0\t1\t2\n\
                 0x12345678\t0x08\t0x10\t0x18\t0x20\t0x28\t0x30\t0\t1\t2\n"
            ),
        ),
        (
            "notes/alpha.md",
            "# Alpha notes\n\nAlpha_Draw at 0x1000 (VA 0x140001000) draws 0x1A2B3C4D.\n\n## Q1 Allocation\n\
             FUN_140002000 is Beta_Setup; Beta_Setup again. Unknown 0xCAFEBABE stays unknown.\n\n### Detail [V]\n\
             ModB:mid-hook:0BADF00D_1234 sits inside Alpha_Draw.\n```\n## not a heading\n```\n"
                .into(),
        ),
        (
            "frame/MAP.md",
            "# Synthetic frame map\n\n## 2. Colour chain\n\n### 2d. Tonemap (seg 9)\n\n\
             | Draw | Pass | Limits | Status |\n|---|---|---|---|\n\
             | 10 | **0x1A2B3C4D** tonemap | clips above c8.w [C] | V / C (s1) |\n\
             | 11 | 0x00C0FFEE glare | darkens >1 (H) | V |\n\n\
             ### 2f. Composite 0x2B3C4D5E [V/C, all H for code]\n\n\
             | Step | Math | Limit |\n|---|---|---|\n\
             | 0 | `min(rgb*c0.x, c0.w)` per channel | hard clip |\n\
             | 1 | PQ encode, `|x|` | - |\n\n\
             ### 2g. Limits\n\n| # | Location | Limit | Status |\n|---|---|---|---|\n\
             | 1 | 0x1A2B3C4D | above c8.w discarded | V |\n\n## 3. Controls\ntext\n"
                .into(),
        ),
    ];
    for (name, text) in files {
        std::fs::write(kb.join(name), text).unwrap();
    }
    kb
}

/// A synthetic REA evidence id.
pub fn ev(n: u32) -> String {
    format!("ev_{n:064x}")
}

/// The analysis profile digest of [`fake_bundle`]'s records, `profile` 1 or 2.
pub fn profile(n: u32) -> String {
    sha(0x700 + n)
}

/// A synthetic REA evidence bundle for the exe `exe_sha256`, analysed with `profile(p)`, written to `path`: a
/// decompile of 0x140001000 (`ev(base)`), its callers 0x140002000 and the unknown 0x140009000 (`ev(base + 1)`), and a
/// record without a subject (`ev(base + 2)`).
pub fn fake_bundle(path: &Path, exe_sha256: &str, p: u32, base: u32) -> PathBuf {
    let provider = serde_json::json!({"id": "ghidra", "name": "Ghidra", "version": "12.1.4"});
    let record = |id: u32, subject: Value, operation: &str, raw: Value| {
        serde_json::json!({
            "evidence_id": ev(id),
            "subject": subject,
            "provider": provider,
            "analysis_profile": {
                "provider": provider,
                "parameters": {"analysis_seeds": {"path": "%KB%/seeds/synthetic.tsv", "sha256": sha(0x5eed + p)}},
                "digest": profile(p),
            },
            "predicate_type": "rea.static",
            "operation": operation,
            "parameters": {"procedure": "0x140001000", "document": "game.exe"},
            "raw_result": raw,
            "normalized_result": {},
            "confidence": "observed",
            "authority": "shipped-artifact",
            "environment": null,
            "limitations": [],
            "locations": [{"kind": "address", "address": "0x140001000"}],
            "evidence_links": [],
        })
    };
    let subject = serde_json::json!({"name": "game.exe", "digest": {"sha256": exe_sha256}, "format": "pe",
                                     "architecture": "x86_64", "local_path": "%GAME_DIR%/game.exe"});
    let bundle = serde_json::json!({
        "artifacts": [], "providers": [provider], "environments": [], "scenarios": [], "captures": [], "unknowns": [],
        "records": [
            record(base, subject.clone(), "procedure_pseudo_code", serde_json::json!("void synthetic(void) {}")),
            record(base + 1, subject, "procedure_callers", serde_json::json!(["0x140002000", "ram:0x140009000"])),
            record(base + 2, Value::Null, "build_reconstruction_obligation_ledger", serde_json::json!({})),
        ],
    });
    std::fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(path, bundle.to_string()).unwrap();
    path.into()
}
```

`crates/quen-core/tests/ledger_db.rs`:

```rs
//! Opening, migrations, the read-only query and search, and typed ingest (docs/intent.md, "The ledger").

mod ledger_common;

use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use ledger_common::{TempDb, boot, capture, fake_kb, game, measurement, rows, sha};
use quen_core::hdr::Encoding;
use quen_core::ledger::{
    BootEnd, BootModStatus, BootStart, Capture, Claim, Error, Game, Hit, Ledger, LoadStatus,
    Measurement, ModVersion, Outcome, PlayerPose, Pose, Provenance, ReTarget, Row, SCHEMA_VERSION,
    Save, Tag,
};
use quen_core::mods::{Kind, ModEntry};
use rusqlite::Connection;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn pragma(path: &std::path::Path, name: &str) -> Value {
    let c = Connection::open(path).unwrap();
    c.query_row(&format!("PRAGMA {name}"), [], |r| {
        Ok(match r.get_ref(0)? {
            rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Integer(n) => json!(n),
            v => json!(v.as_str().unwrap()),
        })
    })
    .unwrap()
}

fn refused(r: Result<impl std::fmt::Debug, Error>, needle: &str) {
    match r {
        Err(Error::Refused(why)) => assert!(why.contains(needle), "{why:?} lacks {needle:?}"),
        other => panic!("expected a refusal about {needle:?}, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn open_migrates_once_with_wal_and_foreign_keys() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    let mut l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    let fk = rows(&l, "SELECT foreign_keys FROM pragma_foreign_keys", &[]);
    assert_eq!(fk, vec![vec![json!(1)]]);
    drop(l);

    assert_eq!(pragma(&db.0, "user_version"), json!(SCHEMA_VERSION));
    assert_eq!(pragma(&db.0, "journal_mode"), json!("wal"));
    let l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT id FROM games", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(g)]],
        "reopening keeps the rows"
    );
    let tables = rows(

        &[],
    );
    let names: Vec<&str> = tables.iter().map(|r| r[0].as_str().unwrap()).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        names,
        [
            "ab_runs",

#[test]
fn open_refuses_a_newer_ledger_and_foreign_databases_untouched() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    drop(Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap());
    Connection::open(&db.0)
        .unwrap()
        .pragma_update(None, "user_version", 99)
        .unwrap();
    refused(Ledger::open(&db.0).map(|_| ()), "newer");
    refused(Ledger::open_readonly(&db.0).map(|_| ()), "newer");
    assert_eq!(pragma(&db.0, "user_version"), json!(99));
    assert!(
        !db.dir().join("backups").exists(),
        "a refusal backs nothing up"
    );

    let other = TempDb::new();
    Connection::open(&other.0)
        .unwrap()
        .execute_batch("CREATE TABLE notes (x TEXT)")
        .unwrap();
    refused(Ledger::open(&other.0).map(|_| ()), "isn't a quen ledger");
    refused(
        Ledger::open_readonly(&other.0).map(|_| ()),
        "not a quen ledger",
    );
    assert_eq!(
        pragma(&other.0, "journal_mode"),
        json!("delete"),
        "not switched to WAL"
    );
    assert_eq!(pragma(&other.0, "user_version"), json!(0));
}

#[test]

#[test]
fn query_runs_one_read_only_statement_with_params() {
    let l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let out = l
        .query(
            "-- a comment\n/* and another */ select ?1 AS n, ?2 AS s, ?3 AS b, ?4 AS x, 0.5 AS r, NULL AS z, x'ab' AS blob;",
            &[json!(7), json!("text"), json!(true), json!(1.25)],
            Duration::from_secs(5),
        )
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(out.columns, ["n", "s", "b", "x", "r", "z", "blob"]);
    assert_eq!(
        out.rows,
        vec![vec![
            json!(7),
            json!("text"),
            json!(1),
            json!(1.25),
            json!(0.5),
            Value::Null,
            json!("ab")
        ]]
    );
    let with = rows(
        &l,
        "WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM c WHERE i < 3) SELECT sum(i) FROM c",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(with, vec![vec![json!(6)]]);

    for sql in [
        "INSERT INTO claims (text) VALUES ('x')",
        "PRAGMA user_version = 5",
        "SELECT 1; SELECT 2",
        "SELECT 1; DELETE FROM claims",
        "WITH x AS (SELECT 1) DELETE FROM claims",
        "-- SELECT\nDELETE FROM claims",
        "VALUES (1)",
        "ATTACH ':memory:' AS other",
        "",
    ] {
        refused(l.query(sql, &[], Duration::from_secs(1)), "SELECT or WITH");
    }
    refused(
        l.query("SELECT ?1", &[json!([1])], Duration::from_secs(1)),
        "parameters",
    );
    assert!(matches!(
        l.query("SELECT ?1, ?2", &[json!(1)], Duration::from_secs(1)),
        Err(Error::Sqlite(_))
    ));
}

#[test]
fn query_stops_at_its_time_limit() {
    let l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let start = Instant::now();
    let endless =
        "WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM c) SELECT count(*) FROM c";
    assert!(matches!(
        l.query(endless, &[], Duration::from_millis(200)),
        Err(Error::TimeLimit)
    ));
    assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5));
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT 1", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(1)]],
        "the connection still works"
    );
}

/// ledger_search's core: a word is found in a claim's text, a measurement's note and the KB's index, in any ASCII case,
/// by table, then id; `%` and `_` are plain characters.
#[test]
fn search_finds_text_across_tables_literally_in_any_case() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    let mut l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    l.add_game(&Game {
        name: "synthetic".into(),
        exe_path: "%GAME_DIR%/bin/x64/game.exe".into(),
        exe_sha256: sha(1),
        build_stamp: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    l.scan_kb(&fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1))).unwrap();
    let c = l
        .add_claim(&Claim {
            text: "Zephyr clips at 50% white".into(),
            scope: None,
        })
        .unwrap();
    let mut note = |text: &str| {
        l.add_measurement(&Measurement {
            boot_id: None,
            capture_id: None,
            metric: "frame_ms".into(),
            value: Some(1.0),
            unit: None,
            state_label: None,
            method_family: "tracy".into(),
            tag: Tag::M,
            run_id: None,
            note: Some(text.into()),
            extraction_id: None,
            world: None,
        })
        .unwrap()
    };
    let m = note("ZEPHYR ran 500 frames");
    note("BetaXSetup ran");
    let find = |text: &str| l.search(text, Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap();
    let hit = |table: &str, id: i64, column: &str, excerpt: &str| Hit {
        table: table.into(),
        id: Some(id),
        column: column.into(),
        excerpt: excerpt.into(),
    };
    assert_eq!(
        find("zephyr"),
        [
            hit("claims", c, "text", "Zephyr clips at 50% white"),
            hit("measurements", m, "note", "ZEPHYR ran 500 frames"),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        find("50%"),
        [hit("claims", c, "text", "Zephyr clips at 50% white")]
    );
    let key = find("beta_setup");
    assert!(
        key.iter().any(
            |h| (h.table.as_str(), h.column.as_str(), h.excerpt.as_str())
                == ("entities", "key", "Beta_Setup")
        ),
        "{key:?}"
    );
    assert!(key.iter().all(|h| h.table != "measurements"), "{key:?}");
    let heading = find("ALLOCATION");
    assert!(
        heading
            .iter()
            .any(|h| (h.table.as_str(), h.column.as_str()) == ("kb_sections", "heading")),
        "{heading:?}"
    );
}

/// A table no code knows, as a later migration would add, is searched too; one WITHOUT ROWID gives no id; a blob is not
/// text; a long value's excerpt is cut on character boundaries; the search stops at its time limit.
#[test]
fn search_reads_the_tables_from_the_database_itself() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    drop(Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap());
    let long = format!("{}needle{}", "é".repeat(100), "ü".repeat(100));
    Connection::open(&db.0)
        .unwrap()
        .execute_batch(&format!(
            "CREATE TABLE future_notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT, raw BLOB);
             CREATE TABLE future_pairs (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT) WITHOUT ROWID;
             INSERT INTO future_notes VALUES (7, '{long}', NULL), (8, 'none here', x'6e6565646c65');
             INSERT INTO future_pairs VALUES ('a', 'a Needle');"
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let l = Ledger::open_readonly(&db.0).unwrap();
    let side = (120 - "needle".len()) / 2;
    let cut = format!("…{}needle{}…", "é".repeat(side), "ü".repeat(side));
    assert_eq!(
        l.search("NEEDLE", Duration::from_secs(10)).unwrap(),
        [
            Hit {
                table: "future_notes".into(),
                id: Some(7),
                column: "body".into(),
                excerpt: cut,
            },
            Hit {
                table: "future_pairs".into(),
                id: None,
                column: "v".into(),
                excerpt: "a Needle".into(),
            },
        ]
    );
    assert!(matches!(
        l.search("needle", Duration::ZERO),
        Err(Error::TimeLimit)
    ));
    refused(l.search("", Duration::from_secs(1)), "empty");
}

#[test]
fn games_mod_sets_and_saves_are_added_on_first_sight() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    assert_eq!(game(&mut l), g);

    let entry = |name: &str, parked| ModEntry {
        kind: Kind::ModsFolder,
        name: name.into(),
        home: format!("%GAME_DIR%/Mods/{name}").into(),
        parked,
        content_hash: sha(5),
        file_count: 1,
        bytes: 10,
        config_hash: None,
        config_values: Default::default(),
    };
    let a = l
        .add_mod_set(&[entry("modA", false), entry("modB", true)])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        l.add_mod_set(&[entry("modB", true), entry("modA", false)])
            .unwrap(),
        a,
        "order doesn't matter"
    );
    let b = l
        .add_mod_set(&[entry("modA", false), entry("modB", false)])
        .unwrap();
    assert_ne!(a, b, "parking is part of the set");
    let parked = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT name FROM mod_set_entries WHERE mod_set_id = ?1 AND parked = 1",
        &[json!(a)],
    );
    assert_eq!(parked, vec![vec![json!("modB")]]);
    refused(
        l.add_mod_set(&[entry("modA", false), entry("modA", true)]),
        "twice",
    );
    refused(l.add_mod_set(&[entry("mod\tA", false)]), "tab");

    let save = |by| Save {
        game_id: g,
        file: "slot_1.sav".into(),
        sha256: sha(7),
        note: None,
        tainted_by_boot: by,
        made_by_boot: by,
    };
    let s = l.add_save(&save(None)).unwrap();
    let b = boot(&mut l, g, "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z");
    assert_eq!(l.add_save(&save(Some(b))).unwrap(), s);
    assert_eq!(l.add_save(&save(None)).unwrap(), s);
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT tainted_by_boot, made_by_boot FROM saves", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(b), json!(b)]],
        "taint and maker are kept"
    );
    assert!(
        l.add_save(&Save {
            game_id: 999,
            ..save(None)
        })
        .is_err(),
        "foreign keys are on"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_boot_starts_finishes_and_is_reviewed_once_finished() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    let settings = json!({"Rendering": {"MtRender": "true"}});
    let display = json!({"hdr": true, "sdr_white_nits": 240});
    let b = l
        .start_boot(&BootStart {
            game_id: g,
            t_start: "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z".into(),
            settings_diff: settings.as_object().cloned(),
            display_state: display.as_object().cloned(),
            devkit: Some(false),
            fg: Some(false),
            profiler: Some("nsys".into()),
            journal_path: Some(r"%LOCALAPPDATA%\quen\state\journal.jsonl".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .unwrap();
    refused(l.review(b, "2026-10-10T12:00:00Z"), "hasn't finished");

    let end = |t: &str, outcome, failure: Option<&str>| BootEnd {
        t_end: t.into(),
        outcome,
        failure: failure.map(String::from),
        patches: vec![json!({"name": "tlas_mask", "rva": "0x1000"})],
    };
    assert!(
        l.finish_boot(b, &end("2026-10-10T09:00:00Z", Outcome::Ok, None))
            .is_err(),
        "ends before it started"
    );
    assert!(
        l.finish_boot(b, &end("2026-10-10 11:00:00", Outcome::Ok, None))
            .is_err(),
        "not UTC ISO-8601"
    );
    assert!(
        l.finish_boot(b, &end("2026-10-10T11:00:00Z", Outcome::Failed, None))
            .is_err(),
        "a failure needs its text"
    );
    // An end that left its journal: why and the patches go on the boot, which stays open for the recovery.
    l.hold_boot(b, "the replay left steps", &[json!({"name": "x"})])
        .unwrap();
    let held = l
        .query(
            &format!("SELECT t_end, failure, patches FROM boots WHERE id = {b}"),
            &[],
            Duration::from_secs(5),
        )
        .unwrap()
        .rows;
    assert_eq!(
        held[0],
        [
            Value::Null,
            json!("the replay left steps"),
            json!(r#"[{"name":"x"}]"#)
        ]
    );
    l.finish_boot(b, &end("2026-10-10T11:00:00Z", Outcome::Ok, None))
        .unwrap();
    refused(
        l.finish_boot(b, &end("2026-10-10T11:30:00Z", Outcome::Ok, None)),
        "already finished",
    );
    refused(l.hold_boot(b, "late", &[]), "already finished");
    refused(
        l.finish_boot(999, &end("2026-10-10T11:30:00Z", Outcome::Ok, None)),
        "no boot 999",
    );

    assert!(
        l.review(b, "2026-10-10T10:30:00Z").is_err(),
        "reviewed before it ended"
    );
    l.review(b, "2026-10-11T08:00:00Z").unwrap();
    refused(l.review(999, "2026-10-11T08:00:00Z"), "no boot 999");
    let r = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT json_extract(settings_diff, '$.Rendering.MtRender'), json_extract(display_state, '$.sdr_white_nits'),
           json_extract(patches, '$[0].name'), devkit, rebar, outcome, reviewed_at FROM boots",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(
        r,
        vec![vec![
            json!("true"),
            json!(240),
            json!("tlas_mask"),
            json!(0),
            Value::Null,
            json!("ok"),
            json!("2026-10-11T08:00:00Z")
        ]]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_boot_records_what_kept_the_machine_busy() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    let start = |busy_with: Option<Vec<String>>| BootStart {
        game_id: g,
        t_start: "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z".into(),
        busy_with,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let unchecked = l.start_boot(&start(None)).unwrap();
    let quiet = l.start_boot(&start(Some(vec![]))).unwrap();
    let busy = l
        .start_boot(&start(Some(vec!["rustc.exe".into()])))
        .unwrap();
    let flags = |l: &Ledger| {
        rows(
            l,
            "SELECT boot_id, busy, busy_with FROM boot_conditions ORDER BY boot_id",
            &[],
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(
        flags(&l),
        [
            vec![json!(unchecked), Value::Null, Value::Null],
            vec![json!(quiet), json!(0), json!("[]")],
            vec![json!(busy), json!(1), json!(r#"["rustc.exe"]"#)],
        ]
    );

    // Later checks add what they found, sorted and once each; a quiet check never clears a busy one.
    l.record_quiet_check(unchecked, &[]).unwrap();
    l.record_quiet_check(quiet, &["java.exe".into(), "cargo.exe".into()])
        .unwrap();
    l.record_quiet_check(busy, &["cargo.exe".into(), "rustc.exe".into()])
        .unwrap();
    l.record_quiet_check(busy, &[]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        flags(&l),
        [
            vec![json!(unchecked), json!(0), json!("[]")],
            vec![json!(quiet), json!(1), json!(r#"["cargo.exe","java.exe"]"#)],
            vec![json!(busy), json!(1), json!(r#"["cargo.exe","rustc.exe"]"#)],
        ]
    );
    l.finish_boot(
        busy,
        &BootEnd {
            t_end: "2026-10-10T11:00:00Z".into(),
            outcome: Outcome::Ok,
            failure: None,
            patches: vec![],
        },
    )
    .unwrap();
    refused(l.record_quiet_check(busy, &[]), "already finished");
    refused(l.record_quiet_check(999, &[]), "no boot 999");
}

#[test]
fn a_boot_gets_its_mod_set_once_and_times_are_utc_text() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(l.utc(1_792_242_900).unwrap(), "2026-10-17T13:15:00Z");
    let g = game(&mut l);
    let b = boot(&mut l, g, "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z");
    let entry = ModEntry {
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: "W3Synthetic".into(),
        home: "GAME/bin/x64/W3Synthetic.asi".into(),
        parked: false,
        content_hash: sha(7),
        file_count: 1,
        bytes: 1,
        config_hash: None,
        config_values: Default::default(),
    };
    let set = l.add_mod_set(&[entry]).unwrap();
    l.set_boot_mod_set(b, set).unwrap();
    refused(l.set_boot_mod_set(b, set), "has its mod set already");
    refused(l.set_boot_mod_set(999, set), "no boot 999");
    let r = rows(&l, "SELECT mod_set_id FROM boots", &[]);
    assert_eq!(r, vec![vec![json!(set)]]);
    // Feature tests 2b: the devkit goes on an unfinished boot's row once the launch saw it loaded.
    let diff = serde_json::Map::from_iter([("conditions".into(), json!(["devkit"]))]);
    refused(l.set_boot_devkit(b, &diff), "has already finished");
    let start = BootStart {
        game_id: g,
        t_start: "2026-10-10T12:00:00Z".into(),
        devkit: Some(false),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let live = l.start_boot(&start).unwrap();
    l.set_boot_devkit(live, &diff).unwrap();
    let sql = "SELECT devkit, settings_diff FROM boots WHERE id = ?1";
    let r = rows(&l, sql, &[json!(live)]);
    assert_eq!(
        r,
        vec![vec![json!(1), json!(r#"{"conditions":["devkit"]}"#)]]
    );
    refused(l.set_boot_devkit(999, &diff), "no boot 999");
}

#[test]
fn every_enum_value_is_accepted_by_the_schema() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    for &tag in Tag::ALL {
        measurement(&mut l, None, "presentmon", tag);
    }
    for (i, encoding) in [
        Encoding::Srgb8,
        Encoding::PqBt2020U16,
        Encoding::PqCodesF16,
        Encoding::ScrgbF16,
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        l.add_capture(&Capture {
            path: format!("enc/{i}.png"),
            sha256: sha(3),
            kind: "png".into(),
            encoding: Some(encoding),
            t: "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .unwrap();
    }
    for &outcome in Outcome::ALL {
        let b = l
            .start_boot(&BootStart {
                game_id: g,
                t_start: "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z".into(),
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .unwrap();
        let failure =
            (outcome == Outcome::Failed).then(|| "witcher3.exe exited during launch".to_string());
        l.finish_boot(
            b,
            &BootEnd {
                t_end: "2026-10-10T10:05:00Z".into(),
                outcome,
                failure,
                patches: vec![],
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    let stored = rows(&l, "SELECT group_concat(tag, ' ') FROM measurements", &[]);
    assert_eq!(stored, vec![vec![json!("M O I U static_re")]]);

    let b = boot(&mut l, g, "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z");
    let mut n = 0;
    for &kind in Kind::ALL {
        for &provenance in Provenance::ALL {
            n += 1;
            l.add_mod_version(&ModVersion {
                content_hash: sha(n),
                kind,
                name: format!("mod{n}"),
                version: "1.0".into(),
                provenance,
                source: "synthetic".into(),
            })
            .unwrap();
        }
        for &status in LoadStatus::ALL {
            l.add_boot_mod_status(&BootModStatus {
                boot_id: b,
                kind,
                name: format!("{status:?}"),
                status,
                reason: Some("synthetic".into()),
            })
            .unwrap();
        }
    }
    let entries: Vec<ModEntry> = Kind::ALL
        .iter()
        .map(|&kind| ModEntry {
            kind,
            name: "x".into(),
            home: "x".into(),
            parked: false,
            content_hash: sha(1),
            file_count: 1,
            bytes: 1,
            config_hash: None,
            config_values: Default::default(),
        })
        .collect();
    l.add_mod_set(&entries).unwrap();
    let stored = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM mod_versions), (SELECT count(*) FROM boot_mod_status),
           (SELECT group_concat(kind, ' ') FROM mod_set_entries)",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(
        stored,
        vec![vec![
            json!(21),
            json!(21),
            json!("addon asi bin dlc menu mods reshade")
        ]]
    );
}

#[test]
fn captures_are_stored_relative_to_the_capture_root() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let t = "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z";
    let c = capture(&mut l, None, r"ngfx\TAG\.\frame1.png", t);
    capture(&mut l, None, "./ini//perf_A.csv", t);
    let paths = rows(&l, "SELECT path FROM captures ORDER BY id", &[]);
    assert_eq!(
        paths,
        vec![
            vec![json!("ngfx/TAG/frame1.png")],
            vec![json!("ini/perf_A.csv")]
        ]
    );
    for bad in [
        r"D:\fixture\cap\x.png",
        "/fixture/x.png",
        "../x.png",
        "ngfx/../../x.png",
        "ngfx/",
        "",
    ] {
        refused(
            l.add_capture(&Capture {
                path: bad.into(),
                sha256: sha(2),
                t: t.into(),
                ..Default::default()
            }),
            "relative",
        );
    }
    assert!(
        l.add_capture(&Capture {
            path: "NGFX/tag/FRAME1.png".into(),
            sha256: sha(2),
            t: t.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .is_err(),
        "paths are unique ignoring case"
    );
    assert!(
        l.add_capture(&Capture {
            path: "x.png".into(),
            sha256: "ABC".into(),
            t: t.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .is_err(),
        "sha256 is 64 lowercase hex"
    );

    let p = l
        .add_pose(&Pose {
            name: "P1".into(),
            camera: [1.0, 2.0, 3.0],
            rotation: [-10.0, 90.0, 0.0],
            fov: 60.0,
            player: Some(PlayerPose {
                position: [1.5, 2.5, 0.0],
                yaw: Some(45.0),
            }),
            ref_capture_id: Some(c),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .unwrap();
    l.add_pose(&Pose {
        name: "P2".into(),
        fov: 50.0,
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .unwrap();
    assert!(
        l.add_pose(&Pose {
            name: "P1".into(),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .is_err(),
        "pose names are unique"
    );
    let r = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT cam_yaw, player_yaw, ref_capture_id FROM poses WHERE id = ?1",
        &[json!(p)],
    );
    assert_eq!(r, vec![vec![json!(90.0), json!(45.0), json!(c)]]);

    // Schema 0012: a player position without a yaw.
    let row = json!({"table": "poses", "name": "P3", "camera": [0, 0, 0], "rotation": [0, 0, 0], "fov": 60,
                     "player": {"position": [4, 5, 6]}});
    let ids = l.ingest(&[Row::from_json(&row).unwrap()]).unwrap();
    let r = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT player_x, player_y, player_z, player_yaw FROM poses WHERE id = ?1",
        &[json!(ids[0])],
    );
    assert_eq!(
        r,
        vec![vec![json!(4.0), json!(5.0), json!(6.0), Value::Null]]
    );
}

/// Finding 32: rows an older quen took with another family are listed by family, read only, and stay as written.
#[test]
fn unknown_families_lists_older_rows_without_touching_them() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    drop(Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap());
    Connection::open(&db.0)
        .unwrap()
        .execute_batch(
            "INSERT INTO measurements (metric, method_family, tag) VALUES ('a', 'rea', 'static_re'), \
             ('b', 'tracy', 'M'), ('c', 'dxil', 'static_re'), ('d', 'rea', 'O')",
        )
        .unwrap();
    let l = Ledger::open_readonly(&db.0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        l.unknown_families().unwrap(),
        [
            ("dxil".to_string(), vec![3]),
            ("rea".to_string(), vec![1, 4])
        ]
    );
    let families = "SELECT group_concat(method_family) FROM measurements";
    assert_eq!(rows(&l, families, &[]), [[json!("rea,tracy,dxil,rea")]]);
}

#[test]
fn rows_deserialize_from_json_and_refuse_unknown_fields() {
    let m: Measurement = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "boot_id": null, "capture_id": null, "metric": "rva_writes", "value": 1.0, "unit": null, "state_label": null,
        "method_family": "static_re", "tag": "static_re", "run_id": null, "note": "synthetic"
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m.tag, Tag::StaticRe);
    let c: Capture = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "path": "a.png", "sha256": sha(1), "bytes": 3, "kind": "png", "t": "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z", "encoding": "pq_bt2020_u16"
    }))
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((c.encoding, c.pinned), (Some(Encoding::PqBt2020U16), false));
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<Claim>(json!({"text": "x", "scoep": "typo"})).is_err());
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<ReTarget>(json!({"claim": 4})).unwrap() == ReTarget::Claim(4));

    // Feature tests 2c: a flag as ledger_query shows it (0 or 1) is taken; a refusal names its field.
    let row = |extra: Value| {
        let mut row = json!({"table": "captures", "path": "a.png", "sha256": sha(1), "bytes": 3, "kind": "png",
                             "t": "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z"});
        row.as_object_mut()
            .unwrap()
            .extend(extra.as_object().unwrap().clone());
        Row::from_json(&row)
    };
    let Ok(Row::Capture(c)) =
        row(json!({"includes_overlay": 0, "includes_desktop": 1, "pinned": 1}))
    else {
        panic!("0 and 1 are flags");
    };
    assert_eq!(
        (c.includes_overlay, c.includes_desktop, c.pinned),
        (Some(false), Some(true), true)
    );
    for (extra, why) in [
        (json!({"includes_overlay": 2}), "includes_overlay: "),
        (
            json!({"frame_state": "{}"}),
            "frame_state: invalid type: string",
        ),
        (json!({"bytes": "3"}), "bytes: invalid type: string"),
        (json!({"encoding": "rgb"}), "encoding: unknown variant"),
        (json!({"scoep": 1}), "unknown field `scoep`"),
    ] {
        let e = row(extra).err().unwrap();
        assert!(e.starts_with(why), "{why}: {e}");
    }
    let e = Row::from_json(&json!({"table": "captures", "path": "a.png"}))
        .err()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(e.starts_with("missing field"), "{e}");
    let e = Row::from_json(&json!({"table": "boots", "path": "a.png"}))
        .err()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(e.starts_with("unknown variant `boots`"), "{e}");
}

#[test]
fn several_processes_can_create_the_same_ledger_at_once() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    // Each open's error, so a failure says why (2 of 4 failed once on CI's Windows runner, 2026-10-19).
    let opened: Vec<Result<(), String>> = std::thread::scope(|s| {
        let handles: Vec<_> = (0..4)
            .map(|_| s.spawn(|| Ledger::open(&db.0).map(drop).map_err(|e| e.to_string())))
            .collect();
        handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect()
    });
    assert!(opened.iter().all(Result::is_ok), "{opened:?}");
    assert_eq!(pragma(&db.0, "user_version"), json!(SCHEMA_VERSION));
}
```

`crates/quen-core/tests/ledger_knowledge.rs`:

```rs
//! Game knowledge (schema 0009) on synthetic fixtures: the KB scan, the KB claim import, the REA
//! bundle import (the extraction cache), `about` and the KB export. Every import, repeated, adds nothing.

mod ledger_common;

use std::fs;

use ledger_common::{TempDb, commit, ev, fake_bundle, fake_kb, profile, rows, sha};
use quen_core::ledger::{About, Error, Game, Ledger, extraction_key};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// A ledger with the synthetic game `exe` (sha(1)), and the fixture's folder.
fn ledger() -> (TempDb, Ledger) {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    let mut l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    l.add_game(&Game {
        name: "synthetic".into(),
        exe_path: "%GAME_DIR%/bin/x64/game.exe".into(),
        exe_sha256: sha(1),
        build_stamp: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    (db, l)
}

fn refused<T: std::fmt::Debug>(r: Result<T, Error>, needle: &str) {
    match r {
        Err(Error::Refused(why)) => assert!(why.contains(needle), "{why}"),
        other => panic!("expected a refusal with {needle:?}, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

/// Every row of the knowledge tables, in a fixed order: a rescan or re-import must leave them as they were.
fn snapshot(l: &Ledger) -> Vec<Vec<Vec<Value>>> {
    [
        "SELECT id, game, kind, key, label FROM entities ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT entity_id, game_id, rva, offset, kb_source, confidence FROM entity_addresses ORDER BY 1, 2",
        "SELECT id, src_id, rel, dst_id, claim_id, extraction_id, kb_source FROM links ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT id, path, anchor, heading, level, parent_id, line_start, line_end, sha256, kb_commit, gone_at
         FROM kb_sections ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT section_id, entity_id, n FROM kb_mentions ORDER BY 1, 2",
        "SELECT id, key, text, scope, confidence, review FROM claims ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT claim_id, entity_id FROM claim_subjects ORDER BY 1, 2",
        "SELECT id, claim_id, kb_path FROM re_refs ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT id, path, sha256, kind, method, pinned FROM captures ORDER BY id",
        "SELECT * FROM extraction_profiles ORDER BY digest",
        "SELECT id, evidence_id, key_sha256, rva, entity_id, capture_id FROM extractions ORDER BY id",
    ]
    .iter()
    .map(|sql| rows(l, sql, &[]))
    .collect()
}

#[test]
fn a_kb_scan_mirrors_the_tables_indexes_the_notes_and_repeats_as_a_no_op() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    let scan = l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(scan.commit, commit());
    assert_eq!(
        (scan.game.as_str(), scan.build.as_str()),
        ("synthetic", sha(1).as_str())
    );
    assert_eq!(
        (
            scan.names,
            scan.hooks,
            scan.patches,
            scan.instance_patches,
            scan.cvar_layouts,
            scan.rows_unknown_build
        ),
        (4, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1)
    );
    assert_eq!((scan.notes, scan.links), (2, 2));

    let entities = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT kind, key, label FROM entities ORDER BY kind, key",
        &[],
    );
    let e =
        |kind: &str, key: &str, label: Option<&str>| vec![json!(kind), json!(key), json!(label)];
    let mut want = vec![
        e("function", "Alpha_Draw", None),
        e("function", "Beta_Setup", None),
        e("function", "fn_0BADF00D_3000", None),
        e("hook", "ModA:hook:Alpha_Draw", Some("draw hook")),
        e("hook", "ModB:mid-hook:0BADF00D_1234", Some("inside alpha")),
        e("label", "Gamma_Table", None),
        e("patch", "cull_off", None),
        e("patch", "steer_wide", None),
        e("field", "CFake+0x58", None),
    ];
    want.extend(
        ["default", "flags", "group", "live", "name", "value"]
            .map(|f| e("field", &format!("cvar_object.{f}"), None)),
    );
    want.sort_by_key(|r| (r[0].to_string(), r[1].to_string()));
    assert_eq!(entities, want);
    let source = |file: &str| json!(format!("{file}@{}", commit()));
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT e.key, a.rva, a.offset, a.kb_source, a.confidence FROM entity_addresses a
             JOIN entities e ON e.id = a.entity_id
             WHERE e.key IN ('Alpha_Draw', 'Beta_Setup', 'cvar_object.value', 'steer_wide', 'CFake+0x58')
             ORDER BY e.key",
            &[]
        ),
        [
            vec![json!("Alpha_Draw"), json!(0x1000), Value::Null, source("names.tsv"), json!("O")],
            vec![json!("Beta_Setup"), json!(0x2000), Value::Null, source("names.tsv"), json!("I")],
            vec![json!("CFake+0x58"), Value::Null, json!(0x58), source("instance_patches.tsv"), Value::Null],
            vec![json!("cvar_object.value"), Value::Null, json!(0x20), source("cvar_layout.tsv"), Value::Null],
            vec![json!("steer_wide"), json!(0x5000), Value::Null, source("instance_patches.tsv"), Value::Null],
        ]
    );
    // A hook at a function's start hooks it; one inside a function is keyed by its site, unlinked. An instance patch
    // sets its field.
    let link = |src: &str, rel: &str, dst: &str, file: &str| {
        vec![
            json!(src),
            json!(rel),
            json!(dst),
            json!("kb"),
            source(file),
        ]
    };
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT src_key, rel, dst_key, basis, kb_source FROM links_evidence ORDER BY src_key",
            &[]
        ),
        [
            link("ModA:hook:Alpha_Draw", "hooks", "Alpha_Draw", "hooks.tsv"),
            link("steer_wide", "sets", "CFake+0x58", "instance_patches.tsv"),
        ]
    );

    // Sections: the preamble, H2s and H3s with their parents; a fenced "##" is no heading.
    let sections = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT s.path, s.anchor, s.level, p.anchor, s.line_start, s.line_end, s.kb_commit FROM kb_sections s
         LEFT JOIN kb_sections p ON p.id = s.parent_id ORDER BY s.path, s.line_start",
        &[],
    );
    let sec = |path: &str, anchor: &str, level: i64, parent: Option<&str>, a: i64, b: i64| {
        vec![
            json!(path),
            json!(anchor),
            json!(level),
            json!(parent),
            json!(a),
            json!(b),
            json!(commit()),
        ]
    };
    assert_eq!(
        sections,
        [
            sec("frame/MAP.md", "", 1, None, 1, 2),
            sec("frame/MAP.md", "2-colour-chain", 2, None, 3, 4),
            sec(
                "frame/MAP.md",
                "2-colour-chain/2d-tonemap-seg-9",
                3,
                Some("2-colour-chain"),
                5,
                11
            ),
            sec(
                "frame/MAP.md",
                "2-colour-chain/2f-composite-0x2b3c4d5e-v-c-all-h-for-code",
                3,
                Some("2-colour-chain"),
                12,
                18
            ),
            sec(
                "frame/MAP.md",
                "2-colour-chain/2g-limits",
                3,
                Some("2-colour-chain"),
                19,
                24
            ),
            sec("frame/MAP.md", "3-controls", 2, None, 25, 26),
            sec("notes/alpha.md", "", 1, None, 1, 4),
            sec("notes/alpha.md", "q1-allocation", 2, None, 5, 7),
            sec(
                "notes/alpha.md",
                "q1-allocation/detail-v",
                3,
                Some("q1-allocation"),
                8,
                12
            ),
        ]
    );
    // Mentions: names, RVAs, VAs and Ghidra names of known functions, a site-keyed hook as written; unknown hex never.
    let mentions = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT s.anchor, e.key, m.n FROM kb_mentions m JOIN kb_sections s ON s.id = m.section_id
         JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.entity_id WHERE s.path = 'notes/alpha.md' ORDER BY s.line_start, e.key",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(
        mentions,
        [
            vec![json!(""), json!("Alpha_Draw"), json!(3)],
            vec![json!("q1-allocation"), json!("Beta_Setup"), json!(3)],
            vec![
                json!("q1-allocation/detail-v"),
                json!("Alpha_Draw"),
                json!(1)
            ],
            vec![
                json!("q1-allocation/detail-v"),
                json!("ModB:mid-hook:0BADF00D_1234"),
                json!(1)
            ],
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE key LIKE '%CAFEBABE%'",
            &[]
        ),
        [[json!(0)]]
    );

    // The same KB again: nothing changes.
    let before = snapshot(&l);
    let again = l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (again.sections_new, again.sections_gone, again.entities_new),
        (0, 0, 0)
    );
    assert_eq!(snapshot(&l), before);

    // An edit at a new commit: a renamed heading is a new section, the old one gone; a removed hook loses its link, the
    // instance patch keeps its own.
    fs::write(db.dir().join("repo/.git/refs/heads/main"), "d".repeat(40)).unwrap();
    let note = kb.join("notes/alpha.md");
    fs::write(
        &note,
        fs::read_to_string(&note)
            .unwrap()
            .replace("Q1 Allocation", "Q1 Pools"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let hooks = kb.join("hooks.tsv");
    let text = fs::read_to_string(&hooks).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        &hooks,
        text.lines()
            .filter(|l| !l.contains("ModA"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let edited = l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (edited.sections_new, edited.sections_gone, edited.links),
        (2, 2, 1)
    );
    assert_eq!(rows(&l, "SELECT count(*) FROM links", &[]), [[json!(1)]]);
    let gone = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT anchor FROM kb_sections WHERE gone_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY anchor",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(
        gone,
        [[json!("q1-allocation")], [json!("q1-allocation/detail-v")]]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT DISTINCT kb_commit FROM kb_sections WHERE gone_at IS NULL",
            &[]
        ),
        [[json!("d".repeat(40))]]
    );
    assert_eq!(l.kb_index().unwrap().unwrap().0, "d".repeat(40));
}

#[test]
fn a_kb_scan_refuses_before_writing_anything() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(2));
    refused(l.scan_kb(&kb), "no game row");
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    let names = kb.join("names.tsv");
    let good = fs::read_to_string(&names).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        &names,
        format!("{good}0x5000\tAlpha_Draw\tfunction\tO\ttest\t2026-10-18\n"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    refused(l.scan_kb(&kb), "Alpha_Draw is defined at line");
    fs::write(&names, good.replace(&sha(1), &sha(3))).unwrap();
    refused(l.scan_kb(&kb), "one KB, one build");
    fs::write(&names, &good).unwrap();
    let instances = kb.join("instance_patches.tsv");
    let rows_before = fs::read_to_string(&instances).unwrap();
    fs::write(&instances, rows_before.replace("steer_wide", "cull_off")).unwrap();
    refused(
        l.scan_kb(&kb),
        "cull_off names a patch in patches.tsv and one in instance_patches.tsv",
    );
    fs::remove_dir_all(db.dir().join("repo/.git")).unwrap();
    refused(l.scan_kb(&kb), "git work tree");
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM entities) + (SELECT count(*) FROM kb_sections)",
            &[]
        ),
        [[json!(0)]]
    );
}

#[test]
fn table_rows_of_a_kb_note_become_keyed_graded_claims_once() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    let wanted = ["2d", "2f", "2g"].map(String::from);
    let scope = Some("HDR on; synthetic capture");
    let first = l
        .import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &wanted, scope)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (first.rows, first.claims_new.len(), first.already),
        (5, 5, 0)
    );
    let claims = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT key, text, scope, confidence, review FROM claims ORDER BY id",
        &[],
    );
    let at = |anchor: &str, text: &str| {
        let key = format!(
            "frame/MAP.md#2-colour-chain/{anchor}/{}",
            &quen_core::journal::sha256_hex(text.as_bytes())[..12]
        );
        json!(key)
    };
    let c = |anchor: &str, text: &str, confidence: Option<&str>, review: Option<&str>| {
        vec![
            at(anchor, text),
            json!(text),
            json!(scope),
            json!(confidence),
            json!(review),
        ]
    };
    let composite = "2f-composite-0x2b3c4d5e-v-c-all-h-for-code";
    assert_eq!(
        claims,
        [
            c(
                "2d-tonemap-seg-9",
                "10 | **0x1A2B3C4D** tonemap | clips above c8.w | (s1)",
                None,
                Some("C")
            ),
            c(
                "2d-tonemap-seg-9",
                "11 | 0x00C0FFEE glare | darkens >1",
                Some("H"),
                Some("V")
            ),
            c(
                composite,
                "0 | `min(rgb*c0.x, c0.w)` per channel | hard clip",
                Some("H"),
                Some("C")
            ),
            c(composite, "1 | PQ encode, `|x|` | -", Some("H"), Some("C")),
            c(
                "2g-limits",
                "1 | 0x1A2B3C4D | above c8.w discarded",
                None,
                Some("V")
            ),
        ]
    );
    // Subjects: the shader hashes each row and its section's heading name; a re_refs row to the section.
    let subjects = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT s.claim_id, e.key FROM claim_subjects s JOIN entities e ON e.id = s.entity_id ORDER BY 1, 2",
        &[],
    );
    let ids = &first.claims_new;
    assert_eq!(
        subjects,
        [
            vec![json!(ids[0]), json!("0x1A2B3C4D")],
            vec![json!(ids[1]), json!("0x00C0FFEE")],
            vec![json!(ids[2]), json!("0x2B3C4D5E")],
            vec![json!(ids[3]), json!("0x2B3C4D5E")],
            vec![json!(ids[4]), json!("0x1A2B3C4D")],
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT kb_path FROM re_refs WHERE claim_id = ?1",
            &[json!(ids[4])]
        ),
        [[json!("frame/MAP.md#2-colour-chain/2g-limits")]]
    );
    // Imported, never proven: no support.
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT sum(proven), sum(families) FROM claims_status",
            &[]
        ),
        [[json!(0), json!(0)]]
    );

    // Again: nothing added. An edited row: a new claim, and the old one listed stale (left open).
    let before = snapshot(&l);
    let again = l
        .import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &wanted, scope)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((again.claims_new.len(), again.already), (0, 5));
    assert_eq!(snapshot(&l), before);
    let map = kb.join("frame/MAP.md");
    fs::write(
        &map,
        fs::read_to_string(&map)
            .unwrap()
            .replace("darkens >1", "darkens >1.0"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let edited = l
        .import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &wanted, scope)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!((edited.claims_new.len(), edited.already), (1, 4));
    assert_eq!(
        edited.stale,
        [at("2d-tonemap-seg-9", "11 | 0x00C0FFEE glare | darkens >1")
            .as_str()
            .unwrap()]
    );

    refused(
        l.import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &["9z".into()], None),
        "no section \"9z\"",
    );
    refused(
        l.import_kb_claims(&kb, "../MAP.md", &wanted, None),
        "relative to the KB root",
    );
    refused(
        l.import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &["3".into()], None),
        "no table rows",
    );
}

#[test]
fn an_rea_bundle_is_copied_pinned_indexed_and_imported_once() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    let root = db.dir().join("captures");
    let outside = fake_bundle(&db.dir().join("export/rea-s1.json"), &sha(1), 1, 10);
    let import = l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &outside, "6.5.0").unwrap();
    let bytes = fs::read(&outside).unwrap();
    let file_sha = quen_core::journal::sha256_hex(&bytes);
    assert_eq!(import.path, format!("re/rea-{}.json", &file_sha[..16]));
    assert!(import.copied);
    assert_eq!(
        fs::read(root.join(&import.path)).unwrap(),
        bytes,
        "the copy is the file"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        (
            import.records,
            import.extractions_new,
            import.skipped,
            import.profiles_new,
            import.links_new
        ),
        (3, 2, 1, 1, 1)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT path, sha256, bytes, kind, method, pinned, boot_id FROM captures",
            &[]
        ),
        [[
            json!(import.path),
            json!(file_sha),
            json!(bytes.len()),
            json!("json"),
            json!("rea"),
            json!(1),
            Value::Null
        ]]
    );
    let params = json!({"document": "game.exe", "procedure": "0x140001000"});
    let key = extraction_key(&sha(1), &profile(1), "procedure_pseudo_code", &params);
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT x.evidence_id, x.tool, x.tool_version, x.operation, x.params, x.key_sha256, x.rva, e.key, x.confidence
             FROM extractions x LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = x.entity_id ORDER BY x.id",
            &[]
        ),
        [
            vec![
                json!(ev(10)),
                json!("rea"),
                json!("6.5.0"),
                json!("procedure_pseudo_code"),
                json!(r#"{"document":"game.exe","procedure":"0x140001000"}"#),
                json!(key),
                json!(0x1000),
                json!("Alpha_Draw"),
                json!("observed"),
            ],
            vec![
                json!(ev(11)),
                json!("rea"),
                json!("6.5.0"),
                json!("procedure_callers"),
                json!(r#"{"document":"game.exe","procedure":"0x140001000"}"#),
                json!(extraction_key(&sha(1), &profile(1), "procedure_callers", &params)),
                json!(0x1000),
                json!("Alpha_Draw"),
                json!("observed"),
            ],
        ]
    );
    // Callers: the known caller only; the unknown address stays in the record.
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT src_key, rel, dst_key, basis, evidence_id, confidence FROM links_evidence WHERE basis = 'extraction'",
            &[]
        ),
        [[
            json!("Beta_Setup"),
            json!("calls"),
            json!("Alpha_Draw"),
            json!("extraction"),
            json!(ev(11)),
            json!("observed")
        ]]
    );
    // No decompiled text in the ledger: only its hash.
    let text = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT count(*) FROM extractions WHERE params LIKE '%synthetic%' OR operation LIKE '%void%'",
        &[],
    );
    assert_eq!(text, [[json!(0)]]);

    // Again, from outside or from its copy: nothing added, nothing copied.
    let before = snapshot(&l);
    for path in [outside.clone(), root.join(&import.path)] {
        let again = l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &path, "6.5.1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (again.extractions_new, again.copied, again.capture_id),
            (0, false, import.capture_id)
        );
    }
    assert_eq!(snapshot(&l), before);
    assert_eq!(fs::read_dir(root.join("re")).unwrap().count(), 1);

    // A bundle exported under the capture root stays where it is.
    let inside = fake_bundle(&root.join("re/s2/rea-a.json"), &sha(1), 2, 20);
    let second = l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &inside, "6.5.0").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        (second.path.as_str(), second.copied, second.profiles_new),
        ("re/s2/rea-a.json", false, 1)
    );

    // Refused, nothing written.
    let n = rows(&l, "SELECT count(*) FROM extractions", &[]);
    let bad = db.dir().join("bad.json");
    for (text, why) in [
        ("[]", "no records list"),
        (
            r#"{"records": [{"evidence_id": "ev_x"}]}"#,
            "record 0: evidence_id",
        ),
    ] {
        fs::write(&bad, text).unwrap();
        refused(l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &bad, "6.5.0"), why);
    }
    let twice = fs::read_to_string(&outside)
        .unwrap()
        .replace(&ev(11), &ev(10));
    fs::write(&bad, twice).unwrap();
    refused(l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &bad, "6.5.0"), "appears twice");
    refused(l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &outside, " "), "REA version");
    assert_eq!(rows(&l, "SELECT count(*) FROM extractions", &[]), n);
}

#[test]
fn records_without_an_address_location_take_the_rva_their_parameters_ask_about() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    l.scan_kb(&fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1))).unwrap();
    // REA 6.5.0's shape: locations empty, the address in the parameters (`procedure`, or `address` for xrefs).
    let path = fake_bundle(&db.dir().join("rea-6.5.0.json"), &sha(1), 1, 10);
    let mut bundle: Value = serde_json::from_str(&fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
    for r in bundle["records"].as_array_mut().unwrap() {
        r["locations"] = json!([]);
    }
    bundle["records"][1]["operation"] = json!("xrefs");
    bundle["records"][1]["parameters"] = json!({"address": "0x140002000"});
    fs::write(&path, bundle.to_string()).unwrap();
    let root = db.dir().join("captures");
    let import = l.import_rea_bundle(&root, &path, "6.5.0").unwrap();
    let extractions = "SELECT x.evidence_id, x.rva, e.key FROM extractions x LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = x.entity_id
                       ORDER BY x.id";
    let alpha = vec![json!(ev(10)), json!(0x1000), json!("Alpha_Draw")];
    let beta = vec![json!(ev(11)), json!(0x2000), json!("Beta_Setup")];
    assert_eq!(rows(&l, extractions, &[]), [alpha.clone(), beta]);

    // As quen 0.1.0 imported it: no rva, no entity. The next open fills that in from the stored parameters, with the
    // bundle file gone, and leaves an rva already set as it is.
    drop(l);
    let raw = rusqlite::Connection::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    raw.execute_batch(&format!(
        "UPDATE extractions SET rva = NULL, entity_id = NULL WHERE evidence_id = '{}';
         UPDATE extractions SET rva = 12288 WHERE evidence_id = '{}';",
        ev(10),
        ev(11)
    ))
    .unwrap();
    drop(raw);
    fs::remove_file(root.join(&import.path)).unwrap();
    let l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    let kept = vec![json!(ev(11)), json!(0x3000), json!("Beta_Setup")];
    assert_eq!(rows(&l, extractions, &[]), [alpha, kept]);
}

#[test]
fn about_gathers_everything_known_and_says_whether_it_was_extracted() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    let root = db.dir().join("captures");
    // The bundle first: its extractions find their function through its address once the KB names it.
    l.import_rea_bundle(
        &root,
        &fake_bundle(&db.dir().join("a.json"), &sha(1), 1, 10),
        "6.5.0",
    )
    .unwrap();
    l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    l.import_rea_bundle(
        &root,
        &fake_bundle(&db.dir().join("b.json"), &sha(1), 2, 20),
        "6.5.0",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let claims = l
        .import_kb_claims(&kb, "frame/MAP.md", &["2g".into()], None)
        .unwrap();

    let ask = |q: Value| {
        l.about(&serde_json::from_value::<About>(q).unwrap())
            .unwrap()
    };
    let about = ask(json!({"kind": "function", "key": "Alpha_Draw"}));
    assert_eq!(about["entity"]["key"], "Alpha_Draw");
    assert_eq!(about["addresses"][0]["rva"], "0x1000");
    assert_eq!(about["addresses"][0]["basis"], "kb");
    let links: Vec<(&str, &str, &str)> = about["links"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|l| {
            (
                l["rel"].as_str().unwrap(),
                l["direction"].as_str().unwrap(),
                l["other"].as_str().unwrap(),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        links,
        [
            ("calls", "in", "function:Beta_Setup"),
            ("hooks", "in", "hook:ModA:hook:Alpha_Draw")
        ]
    );
    let sections: Vec<&str> = about["sections"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s["anchor"].as_str().unwrap())
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(sections, ["", "q1-allocation/detail-v"]);
    assert_eq!(about["extracted"], true);
    // Four records at its address: two per profile; no profile asked, so none exact.
    let n = |group: &str| about["extractions"][group].as_array().unwrap().len();
    assert_eq!((n("exact"), n("near"), n("gone")), (0, 4, 0));

    // The cache key asked for: one exact hit, the other profile's same query near.
    let params = json!({"document": "game.exe", "procedure": "0x140001000"});
    let hit = ask(
        json!({"build": sha(1), "rva": "0x1000", "operation": "procedure_pseudo_code", "params": params,
                         "profile": profile(1)}),
    );
    assert_eq!(hit["entity"]["key"], "Alpha_Draw");
    let key = extraction_key(&sha(1), &profile(1), "procedure_pseudo_code", &params);
    assert_eq!(hit["extractions"]["key_sha256"], json!(key));
    let exact = &hit["extractions"]["exact"];
    assert_eq!(
        (
            exact[0]["evidence_id"].clone(),
            exact[0]["key_sha256"].clone()
        ),
        (json!(ev(10)), json!(key))
    );
    assert_eq!(
        exact[0]["seeds"],
        json!(json!({"path": "%KB%/seeds/synthetic.tsv", "sha256": sha(0x5eed + 1)}).to_string())
    );
    assert_eq!(hit["extractions"]["near"][0]["evidence_id"], json!(ev(20)));
    assert_eq!(exact.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);

    // A shader the claim import named: its claim with its grades and standing.
    let shader = ask(json!({"kind": "shader", "key": "0x1A2B3C4D"}));
    assert_eq!(shader["claims"][0]["id"], json!(claims.claims_new[0]));
    assert_eq!(
        (
            shader["claims"][0]["review"].clone(),
            shader["claims"][0]["proven"].clone()
        ),
        (json!("V"), json!(0))
    );
    // Nothing known is an empty answer; asking about nothing is refused.
    let none = ask(json!({"kind": "function", "key": "Nobody"}));
    assert_eq!(
        (none["entity"].clone(), none["extracted"].clone()),
        (Value::Null, json!(false))
    );
    refused(l.about(&About::default()), "kind and key, or build and rva");
    refused(
        l.about(&About {
            rva: Some("0x1000".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        }),
        "rva needs build",
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_kb_export_lists_keyed_claims_and_their_links_sorted() {
    let (db, mut l) = ledger();
    let kb = fake_kb(db.dir(), &sha(1));
    l.scan_kb(&kb).unwrap();
    l.import_kb_claims(
        &kb,
        "frame/MAP.md",
        &["2g".into(), "2d".into()],
        Some("a\tscope"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    l.add_claim(&quen_core::ledger::Claim {
        text: "unkeyed".into(),
        scope: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    let (claims, links) = l.kb_export().unwrap();
    let lines: Vec<&str> = claims.lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(
        lines[0],
        "key\ttext\tscope\tstatus\twithdrawn_reason\tconfidence\treview\tproven\tfamilies\tsubjects\tkb_refs"
    );
    assert_eq!(lines.len(), 4, "the three keyed claims only:\n{claims}");
    let mut keys: Vec<&str> = lines[1..]
        .iter()
        .map(|l| l.split('\t').next().unwrap())
        .collect();
    let sorted = {
        let mut k = keys.clone();
        k.sort();
        k
    };
    assert_eq!(keys, sorted);
    keys.dedup();
    assert_eq!(keys.len(), 3);
    let row: Vec<&str> = lines
        .iter()
        .find(|l| l.contains("2g-limits"))
        .unwrap()
        .split('\t')
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        &row[1..],
        [
            "1 | 0x1A2B3C4D | above c8.w discarded",
            r"a\tscope",
            "open",
            "",
            "",
            "V",
            "0",
            "0",
            "shader:0x1A2B3C4D",
            "frame/MAP.md#2-colour-chain/2g-limits"
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(links, "src\trel\tdst\tclaim\n", "no claim-backed links yet");
}
```

`crates/quen-core/tests/ledger_mods.rs`:

```rs
//! Mod fingerprints in the ledger: migration 0002, labels and load status (docs/intent.md, "Mod sets").

mod ledger_common;

use ledger_common::{TempDb, boot, game, rows, sha};
use quen_core::ledger::{
    BootModStatus, Error, Ledger, LoadStatus, ModVersion, Provenance, Row, SCHEMA_VERSION,
};
use quen_core::mods::{
    ConfigSource, HashCache, Kind, MemSource, ModEntry, ModSpec, fingerprint, set_hash,
};
use rusqlite::Connection;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn refused(r: Result<(), Error>, needle: &str) {
    match r {
        Err(Error::Refused(why)) => assert!(why.contains(needle), "{why:?} lacks {needle:?}"),
        other => panic!("expected a refusal about {needle:?}, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_0001_ledger_migrates_in_place() {
    let db = TempDb::new();
    let old = Connection::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    old.execute_batch(include_str!("../../../schema/0001_init.sql"))
        .unwrap();
    old.pragma_update(None, "user_version", 1).unwrap();
    old.execute_batch(&format!(
        "INSERT INTO games (id, name, exe_path, exe_sha256) VALUES (1, 'synthetic', '%GAME_DIR%/bin/x64/game.exe', '{}');
         INSERT INTO mod_sets (id, sha256) VALUES (1, '{}');
         INSERT INTO mod_set_entries (mod_set_id, name, kind, sha256, parked)
           VALUES (1, 'modAlpha', 'mod', '{}', 0), (1, 'Tweaks.asi', 'asi', '{}', 1);
         INSERT INTO boots (id, game_id, t_start, mod_set_id) VALUES (1, 1, '2026-10-10T10:00:00Z', 1);",
        sha(1),
        sha(2),
        sha(3),
        sha(4)
    ))
    .unwrap();
    drop(old);

    let mut l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    let version = rows(&l, "SELECT user_version FROM pragma_user_version", &[]);
    assert_eq!(version, vec![vec![json!(SCHEMA_VERSION)]]);
    assert_eq!(SCHEMA_VERSION, 16);
    let entries = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT mod_set_id, kind, name, parked, content_hash, home, file_count, bytes, config_hash, config_values,
           version_label, provenance
         FROM mod_set_entries ORDER BY name",
        &[],
    );
    let legacy = |kind: &str, name: &str, parked: i64, hash: u32| {
        let null = Value::Null;
        vec![
            json!(1),
            json!(kind),
            json!(name),
            json!(parked),
            json!(sha(hash)),
            null.clone(),
            null.clone(),
            null.clone(),
            null.clone(),
            json!("{}"),
            null,
            json!("unknown"),
        ]
    };
    assert_eq!(
        entries,
        [
            legacy("asi", "Tweaks.asi", 1, 4),
            legacy("mod", "modAlpha", 0, 3)
        ],
        "rows keep their values, free-text kinds included"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT mod_set_id FROM boots", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(1)]]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_foreign_key_check", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(0)]]
    );

    // The new key: one name under two kinds.
    let entry = |kind| ModEntry {
        kind,
        name: "W3Perf".into(),
        home: "%GAME_DIR%/bin/x64/W3Perf".into(),
        parked: false,
        content_hash: sha(5),
        file_count: 1,
        bytes: 4,
        config_hash: Some(sha(6)),
        config_values: [("TlasMask".to_string(), "1".to_string())].into(),
    };
    let set = l
        .add_mod_set(&[entry(Kind::Asi), entry(Kind::Addon)])
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(set, 2);
    l.add_boot_mod_status(&BootModStatus {
        boot_id: 1,
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: "Tweaks".into(),
        status: LoadStatus::NotPresent,
        reason: None,
    })
    .unwrap();
    drop(l);

    let raw = Connection::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    assert!(
        raw.execute(
            "INSERT INTO mod_set_entries (mod_set_id, kind, name, parked, home, content_hash, file_count, bytes)
             VALUES (2, 'mod', 'modBeta', 0, 'x', ?1, 1, 1)",
            [sha(7)],
        )
        .is_err(),
        "only rows from 0001 keep a free-text kind"
    );
    drop(raw);
    let l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT count(*) FROM mod_set_entries", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(4)]],
        "reopening doesn't migrate again"
    );
}

#[test]
fn only_a_known_build_gets_a_label() {
    let mut src = MemSource::default();
    src.put("GAME/bin/x64/W3ElementMap.asi", "element map 1.2");
    src.put(
        "GAME/bin/x64/W3ElementMap.ini",
        "[General]\nMode=raise\nRaisePercent=40\n",
    );
    src.put("GAME/bin/x64/W3Perf.asi", "perf, local build");
    src.put("GAME/Mods/modAlpha/content/blob0.bundle", "bundle");
    src.put("GAME/Mods/modAlpha/modAlpha.log", "boot 1");
    let spec = |kind, name: &str, home: &str, config| ModSpec {
        kind,
        name: name.into(),
        home: home.into(),
        parked: false,
        ignore: vec![],
        config,
    };
    let ini = ConfigSource {
        path: "GAME/bin/x64/W3ElementMap.ini".into(),
        section: None,
        keys: vec!["Mode".into(), "RaisePercent".into()],
        qualify: false,
    };
    let specs = [
        spec(
            Kind::Asi,
            "W3ElementMap",
            "GAME/bin/x64/W3ElementMap.asi",
            vec![ini],
        ),
        spec(Kind::Asi, "W3Perf", "GAME/bin/x64/W3Perf.asi", vec![]),
        spec(Kind::ModsFolder, "modAlpha", "GAME/Mods/modAlpha", vec![]),
    ];
    let mut cache = HashCache::default();
    let entries: Vec<ModEntry> = specs
        .iter()
        .map(|s| fingerprint(&src, &mut cache, s).unwrap())
        .collect();

    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    l.add_mod_version(&ModVersion {
        content_hash: entries[0].content_hash.clone(),
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: "W3ElementMap".into(),
        version: "1.2".into(),
        provenance: Provenance::NexusFile,
        source: "W3ElementMap-1-2.zip".into(),
    })
    .unwrap();
    let set = l.add_mod_set(&entries).unwrap();
    let reversed: Vec<ModEntry> = entries.iter().rev().cloned().collect();
    assert_eq!(l.add_mod_set(&reversed).unwrap(), set);
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT sha256 FROM mod_sets", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!(set_hash(&entries).unwrap())]]
    );
    let labels = |l: &Ledger| {
        rows(
            l,
            "SELECT kind || ':' || name, version_label, provenance FROM mod_set_entries ORDER BY 1",
            &[],
        )
    };
    assert_eq!(
        labels(&l),
        vec![
            vec![json!("asi:W3ElementMap"), json!("1.2"), json!("nexus_file")],
            vec![json!("asi:W3Perf"), Value::Null, json!("unknown")],
            vec![json!("mods:modAlpha"), Value::Null, json!("unknown")],
        ],
        "an unknown hash gets no label"
    );
    let stored = rows(
        &l,
        "SELECT home, content_hash, file_count, bytes, config_hash, json_extract(config_values, '$.RaisePercent')
         FROM mod_set_entries WHERE name = 'W3ElementMap'",
        &[],
    );
    let e = &entries[0];
    assert_eq!(
        stored,
        vec![vec![
            json!("GAME/bin/x64/W3ElementMap.asi"),
            json!(e.content_hash),
            json!(1),
            json!(15),
            json!(e.config_hash),
            json!("40"),
        ]]
    );

    // Labeling a build later labels the entries already stored with it.
    let perf = ModVersion {
        content_hash: entries[1].content_hash.clone(),
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: "W3Perf".into(),
        version: "0.3.0-dev".into(),
        provenance: Provenance::GitCommit,
        source: "0123abcd".into(),
    };
    l.add_mod_version(&perf).unwrap();
    l.add_mod_version(&perf).unwrap();
    refused(
        l.add_mod_version(&ModVersion {
            version: "0.4.0".into(),
            ..perf.clone()
        }),
        "different label",
    );
    assert_eq!(
        labels(&l)[1],
        [json!("asi:W3Perf"), json!("0.3.0-dev"), json!("git_commit")]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(&l, "SELECT version FROM mod_versions ORDER BY 1", &[]),
        vec![vec![json!("0.3.0-dev")], vec![json!("1.2")]]
    );
    assert!(
        l.add_mod_version(&ModVersion {
            content_hash: "ABC".into(),
            ..perf
        })
        .is_err(),
        "a content hash is 64 lowercase hex"
    );
}

/// A build from someone else's fork, its commit unknown: ledger_ingest's row labels it `other`, its source free text,
/// and the entries with its hash get the label. A provenance outside the list is refused.
#[test]
fn a_build_from_elsewhere_is_labelled_other() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let label = |provenance: &str| {
        serde_json::from_value::<Vec<Row>>(
            json!([{"table": "mod_versions", "content_hash": sha(8), "kind": "addon",
            "name": "renodx-synthetic", "version": "fork", "provenance": provenance,
            "source": "github.com/owner/repo, commit unknown"}]),
        )
    };
    assert!(label("fork").is_err(), "an unknown provenance");
    l.ingest(&label("other").unwrap()).unwrap();
    let entry = ModEntry {
        kind: Kind::Addon,
        name: "renodx-synthetic".into(),
        home: "bin/x64/renodx-synthetic.addon64".into(),
        parked: false,
        content_hash: sha(8),
        file_count: 1,
        bytes: 6,
        config_hash: None,
        config_values: Default::default(),
    };
    l.add_mod_set(&[entry]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT version_label, provenance FROM mod_set_entries",
            &[]
        ),
        [[json!("fork"), json!("other")]]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_boot_records_what_each_mod_did_at_load() {
    let mut l = Ledger::open_in_memory().unwrap();
    let g = game(&mut l);
    let b = boot(&mut l, g, "2026-10-10T10:00:00Z");
    let status = |name: &str, status, reason: Option<&str>| BootModStatus {
        boot_id: b,
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: name.into(),
        status,
        reason: reason.map(String::from),
    };
    l.add_boot_mod_status(&status("W3ElementMap", LoadStatus::Loaded, None))
        .unwrap();
    l.add_boot_mod_status(&status(
        "W3Perf",
        LoadStatus::Refused,
        Some("REFUSED: game code differs"),
    ))
    .unwrap();
    assert!(
        l.add_boot_mod_status(&status("Tweaks", LoadStatus::Refused, None))
            .is_err(),
        "a refusal needs its reason"
    );
    assert!(
        l.add_boot_mod_status(&status("W3ElementMap", LoadStatus::NotPresent, None))
            .is_err(),
        "one status per mod and boot"
    );
    assert!(
        l.add_boot_mod_status(&BootModStatus {
            boot_id: 999,
            ..status("Tweaks", LoadStatus::Loaded, None)
        })
        .is_err(),
        "the boot must exist"
    );
    let parked: BootModStatus = serde_json::from_value(json!({
        "boot_id": b, "kind": "addon", "name": "renodx", "status": "not_present"
    }))
    .unwrap();
    l.add_boot_mod_status(&parked).unwrap();
    assert!(
        serde_json::from_value::<BootModStatus>(json!({
            "boot_id": b, "kind": "asi", "name": "x", "status": "crashed"
        }))
        .is_err()
    );
    assert_eq!(
        rows(
            &l,
            "SELECT kind, name, status, reason FROM boot_mod_status ORDER BY name",
            &[]
        ),
        vec![
            vec![
                json!("asi"),
                json!("W3ElementMap"),
                json!("loaded"),
                Value::Null
            ],
            vec![
                json!("asi"),
                json!("W3Perf"),
                json!("refused"),
                json!("REFUSED: game code differs")
            ],
            vec![
                json!("addon"),
                json!("renodx"),
                json!("not_present"),
                Value::Null
            ],
        ]
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_mod_set_waits_for_another_writer_instead_of_failing() {
    // A deferred transaction that has read can't take the write lock from a busy writer: SQLite returns BUSY at once,
    // without the busy timeout. add_mod_set reads first, so it takes the write lock up front and waits.
    let db = TempDb::new();
    let mut l = Ledger::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    let other = Connection::open(&db.0).unwrap();
    other
        .execute_batch(&format!(
            "BEGIN IMMEDIATE; INSERT INTO mod_sets (sha256) VALUES ('{}');",
            sha(9)
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let writer = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(300));
        other.execute_batch("COMMIT").unwrap();
    });
    let entry = ModEntry {
        kind: Kind::Asi,
        name: "W3Perf".into(),
        home: "%GAME_DIR%/bin/x64/W3Perf".into(),
        parked: false,
        content_hash: sha(5),
        file_count: 1,
        bytes: 4,
        config_hash: None,
        config_values: Default::default(),
    };
    let set = l.add_mod_set(&[entry]);
    writer.join().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(set.unwrap(), 2, "after the other writer's set");
}
```
