`tools/release/install.ps1`:

```ps1
# quen's installer (INSTALL.md, Quick install), shipped as a release asset beside the zips. It gets one
# quen release from GitHub, or from a folder of its files, and checks every zip against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt
# before opening it. Then it puts quen.exe in %USERPROFILE%\.quen\bin and, unless -NoGamePackage, quen's in-game package
# in the game folder (one Vortex installed is left to Vortex). It installs no third-party tool, needs no admin rights,
# asks before each change, and sends what it replaces or removes to the Recycle Bin. Every check runs before the first
# change: a refusal changes nothing.
# Usage: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1 [-Version <x.y.z>] [-From <folder>] [-GameDir <folder>]
#            [-NoGamePackage] [-WithRenderDoc] [-Update | -Uninstall] [-WhatIf]
# Tested with Windows PowerShell 5.1, the one in Windows. Kept ASCII: it reads a file without a BOM in the ANSI code page.
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [string]$Version,
    [string]$From,
    [string]$GameDir,
    [switch]$NoGamePackage,
    [switch]$WithRenderDoc,
    [switch]$Update,
    [switch]$Uninstall
)
# The body has its own scope, so `irm ... | iex` leaves only the parameters behind in the caller's session.
& {
    try {
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'  # Windows PowerShell's progress bar slows a download many times over
        Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem, Microsoft.VisualBasic

        $Repo = 'snackbar92hypernova/quen-mcp'
        # -WhatIf is this script's own: cmdlets here would take it too, and some then return nothing (ForEach-Object's
        # member form). It is global under -File, so a module's functions still take it: see Sha.
        $dry = [bool]$WhatIfPreference
        $WhatIfPreference = $false
        if (-not $env:USERPROFILE) { throw 'install: USERPROFILE is not set' }
        $quenHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.quen'
        $bin = Join-Path $quenHome 'bin'
        $exe = Join-Path $bin 'quen.exe'
        $slDir = Join-Path $quenHome 'tools\streamline'
        $envKey = 'Environment'  # HKCU's: the user's environment variables
        $done = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]

        function Say($text) { Write-Host "install: $text" }
        function Refuse($why) { throw "install: refused, nothing was changed: $why" }
        function Ask($question) {
            if ($dry) { Write-Host "What if: ask `"$question`" (taken as yes)"; return $true }
            "$(Read-Host "$question [y/N]")".Trim() -match '^(y|yes)$'
        }
        # A change: made now, or with -WhatIf only printed.
        function Change($what, [scriptblock]$do) {
            if ($dry) { Write-Host "What if: $what"; return }
            Say $what
            & $do
            $done.Add($what)
        }
        # A console program in this console (no window of its own): its output lines, stderr folded in, and its exit code.
        # Windows PowerShell turns each stderr line into an error, which 'Stop' would throw on: hence the local Continue.
        function Run {
            $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
            $prog = $args[0]
            $rest = @($args | Select-Object -Skip 1)  # an array even for one: a lone string doesn't splat as one argument
            $out = @(& $prog @rest 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" })
            [pscustomobject]@{ out = $out; code = $LASTEXITCODE }
        }
        # The JSON of `quen setup` or `quen doctor` (both read-only), or $null. quen prints UTF-8; Windows PowerShell would
        # read it in the console's code page.
        function QuenJson($quen, $command) {
            $encoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding
            [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8
            try {
                $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
                $text = (& $quen $command 2>$null) -join "`n"
            } finally { [Console]::OutputEncoding = $encoding }
            try { $text | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $null }
        }
        # By stream: Get-FileHash -LiteralPath, under -WhatIf, hashes nothing.
        function Sha($path) {
            $stream = [IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
            try { (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -InputStream $stream).Hash.ToLower() } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
        }
        # A zip's files: each one's path in the zip (with \) and the sha256 of its bytes.
        function ZipFiles($zipPath) {
            $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zipPath)
            try {
                foreach ($entry in $zip.Entries | Where-Object Name) {
                    $stream = $entry.Open()
                    try { $sha = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -InputStream $stream).Hash.ToLower() } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
                    [pscustomobject]@{ rel = $entry.FullName.Replace('/', '\'); sha = $sha }
                }
            } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
        }
        # Writes one file of a zip to $dest (never over a file) and checks it is the zip's bytes.
        function Place($zipPath, $file, $dest) {
            $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zipPath)
            try {
                [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Split-Path $dest))
                [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::ExtractToFile($zip.GetEntry($file.rel.Replace('\', '/')), $dest)
            } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
            $got = Sha $dest
            if ($got -ne $file.sha) { throw "install: $dest has sha256 $got, not the release's $($file.sha)" }
        }
        # Which of $files are missing or other bytes under $root.
        function Differs($files, $root) {
            @($files | Where-Object { $d = Join-Path $root $_.rel; -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d) -or (Sha $d) -ne $_.sha })
        }
        # Nothing is deleted for good: it goes to the Recycle Bin. QUEN_TEST_RECYCLE_TO (tests only, as in quen's own
        # win::recycle) moves it into that folder instead.
        function Recycle($path) {
            if ($env:QUEN_TEST_RECYCLE_TO) {
                $name = '{0}-{1}' -f [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('n').Substring(0, 8), (Split-Path -Leaf $path)
                Move-Item -LiteralPath $path -Destination (Join-Path $env:QUEN_TEST_RECYCLE_TO $name) -WhatIf:$false
            } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Container) {
                [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteDirectory($path, 'OnlyErrorDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin')
            } else {
                [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($path, 'OnlyErrorDialogs', 'SendToRecycleBin')
            }
        }
        # A drive that isn't fixed (removable, network) has no Recycle Bin: Windows would delete there for good.
        # ponytail: the drive type only, as quen's win::recycle_bin starts; a fixed drive with its bin turned off deletes.
        function NeedsBin($path) {
            $root = [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($path)
            $type = try { ([IO.DriveInfo]$root).DriveType } catch { 'unknown' }
            if (-not $env:QUEN_TEST_RECYCLE_TO -and "$type" -ne 'Fixed') {
                Refuse "$root is no fixed drive, so it has no Recycle Bin, and this installer deletes nothing for good. Move $path yourself"
            }
        }
        function Full($path, $what) {
            try { (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $path).ProviderPath } catch { Refuse "no $what at $path" }
        }
        # quen.exe processes started from $exe: Windows can't replace or remove a running program.
        function Running { @(Get-Process quen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq $exe }) }
        # quen's state, from `quen doctor`: refused while a session runs or its journal is left, since stopping quen or
        # changing the game folder then would leave the folder as the session changed it. Returns the doctor's result.
        function Idle($quen) {
            $doc = QuenJson $quen doctor
            if (-not $doc) { Refuse "$quen doctor answered no JSON" }
            if ($doc.state.config) { Refuse "quen's config doesn't load ($($doc.state.config)): fix it first" }
            if ($doc.state.journal) {
                Refuse "a quen session's journal is there ($($doc.state.journal)): a session is live, or one didn't end. End it (session_end), or run quen recover, then run this again"
            }
            if ($doc.state.lock -is [string]) { Refuse "another quen holds the game lock ($($doc.state.lock)): a session is live there. End it first" }
            $doc
        }
        # The game folder: -GameDir, else the one `quen setup` gives.
        function Find-Game($quen) {
            if ($GameDir) { $dir = Full $GameDir 'folder' } else {
                $g = (QuenJson $quen setup).paths | Where-Object key -eq 'game_dir'
                if (-not $g.path -or $g.problem) {
                    $found = @($g.candidates | ForEach-Object { $_.path }) -join '; '
                    Refuse ("quen setup gives no game folder ($($g.problem))" + $(if ($found) { "; found: $found" }) +
                        '. Run this again with -GameDir <the game folder>, or with -NoGamePackage')
                }
                $dir = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($g.path)
            }
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'bin\x64_dx12') -PathType Container)) {
                Refuse "$dir has no bin\x64_dx12, so it isn't the game folder"
            }
            $w3 = @(Get-Process witcher3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
            if ($w3) { Refuse "The Witcher 3 is running (witcher3.exe, pid $($w3.Id -join ', ')): close it first" }
            $dir
        }
        # Who in Vortex owns quen's package in $game: the source (Vortex's mod folder) of a package file a Vortex
        # deployment manifest lists (vortex.deployment*.json in the game folder or Mods, as quen's mods tool reads them),
        # else 'a hardlink' for a package file with more than one name, as Vortex deploys; $null for neither. Such a
        # package is updated and removed in Vortex: replaced here, Vortex's next deploy would import the new files over
        # its own copy of the old ones.
        function VortexOwner($game) {
            $files = @(@('bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen.asi', 'bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen-licences.txt') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $game $_ } |
                Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ }) +
                @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $game 'Mods\modQuen') -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object FullName)
            foreach ($dir in $game, (Join-Path $game 'Mods')) {
                foreach ($m in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'vortex.deployment*.json' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
                    $json = try { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($m.FullName) | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {
                        Refuse "$($m.FullName) doesn't parse ($($_.Exception.Message)), so whether Vortex owns quen's package can't be told"
                    }
                    $hit = @($json.files | Where-Object { $_.relPath -and (Join-Path $dir "$($_.relPath)".Replace('/', '\')) -in $files })
                    if ($hit) { return $hit[0].source }
                }
            }
            if ($files | Where-Object { (Get-Item -LiteralPath $_ -Force).LinkType -eq 'HardLink' }) { return 'a hardlink' }
            $null
        }
        # The user PATH as Windows keeps it: %VARIABLES% unexpanded, which [Environment]'s User target would expand for good.
        function UserPath {
            $key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser.CreateSubKey($envKey)
            try { [string]$key.GetValue('Path', '', 'DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames') } finally { $key.Close() }
        }
        function IsBin($entry) { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($entry).Trim().TrimEnd('\') -eq $bin }
        function Set-UserPath($value) {
            $key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser.CreateSubKey($envKey)
            try { $key.SetValue('Path', $value, 'ExpandString') } finally { $key.Close() }
            # Programs started from now on see it once Windows is told: WM_SETTINGCHANGE "Environment", to every window.
            if (-not ('QuenInstall.Native' -as [type])) {
                Add-Type -Namespace QuenInstall -Name Native -MemberDefinition ('[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] ' +
                    'public static extern IntPtr SendMessageTimeout(IntPtr hWnd, uint msg, UIntPtr wParam, string lParam, ' +
                    'uint flags, uint timeout, out UIntPtr result);')
            }
            $result = [UIntPtr]::Zero
            [void][QuenInstall.Native]::SendMessageTimeout([IntPtr]0xffff, 0x1a, [UIntPtr]::Zero, $envKey, 2, 5000, [ref]$result)
        }
        # A path that goes to the Recycle Bin, with a folder's files.
        function Show($p) {
            Write-Host "  to the Recycle Bin: $p"
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Container) {
                Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "    $($_.FullName)" }
            }
        }
        function Find-Claude { (Get-Command claude -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source }
        # Claude Code's settings: the text of $path with quen's PreToolUse hook for $quen in it (INSTALL.md section 4),
        # every other setting and hook as it was; $null when it is there already. quen's hook (quen.exe, args focus --to
        # client) leaves every group it is in, a group left with none goes, and it comes last in a group of its own. The
        # matcher is every tool quen marks for a prompt (a quen test pins it). Refused when the file isn't a JSON object.
        # ponytail: PowerShell 7 reads date-like strings as dates and writes them back in its own format; Windows
        # PowerShell 5.1, which this script is tested with, doesn't. Claude Code's settings hold none today.
        function With-Hook($path, $quen) {
            $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path) } else { '' }
            $s = [pscustomobject]@{}
            if ($text.Trim()) {
                try { $s = $text | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Refuse "$path isn't valid JSON ($($_.Exception.Message)). Fix it, or answer no to the hook" }
            }
            if ($s -isnot [Management.Automation.PSCustomObject] -or ($null -ne $s.hooks -and $s.hooks -isnot [Management.Automation.PSCustomObject])) {
                Refuse "$path isn't a JSON object with hooks as an object. Fix it, or answer no to the hook"
            }
            $before = ConvertTo-Json $s -Depth 100 -Compress
            if ($null -eq $s.hooks) { $s | Add-Member hooks ([pscustomobject]@{}) -Force }
            $groups = @(foreach ($g in @($s.hooks.PreToolUse | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })) {
                    $kept = @($g.hooks | Where-Object { -not ([IO.Path]::GetFileName("$($_.command)") -eq 'quen.exe' -and "$($_.args)" -eq 'focus --to client') })
                    if ($kept.Count -lt @($g.hooks).Count) {
                        if (-not $kept.Count) { continue }
                        $g.hooks = $kept
                    }
                    $g
                })
            $groups += [pscustomobject]@{
                matcher = '^mcp__quen__(session_launch|game_save|hands_take|mem_patch_instances|capture_clean|ngfx_replay)$'
                hooks   = @([pscustomobject]@{ type = 'command'; command = $quen; args = @('focus', '--to', 'client'); timeout = 5 })
            }
            # In place, so the other hooks keep their order.
            if ($s.hooks.PSObject.Properties['PreToolUse']) { $s.hooks.PreToolUse = $groups } else { $s.hooks | Add-Member PreToolUse $groups }
            if ((ConvertTo-Json $s -Depth 100 -Compress) -ceq $before) { return $null }
            ConvertTo-Json $s -Depth 100
        }
        function Stop-Quen($procs) {
            Change "stop quen.exe (pid $($procs.Id -join ', '))" {
                $procs | Stop-Process -Force
                $procs | Wait-Process -Timeout 15 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            }
        }
        # ponytail: idle is checked once, before the questions; a session launched while they wait isn't seen.
        function Ask-Stop($procs) {
            if ($procs -and -not (Ask ("quen.exe is running from $bin (pid $($procs.Id -join ', '): your MCP clients' quen and " +
                        'its quen serve; no session is live). Stop it? Your clients then reconnect quen (/mcp in Claude Code)'))) {
                Refuse "quen.exe is running from ${bin}: Windows can't replace or remove a running program. Close your MCP clients first"
            }
        }

        if ($Update -and $Uninstall) { Refuse '-Update and -Uninstall exclude each other' }
        if ($Version) { $Version = $Version.TrimStart('v') }  # the tag is v<version>

        if ($Uninstall) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { Refuse "quen isn't installed at $exe" }
            [void](Idle $exe)
            $procs = Running
            $remove = @($bin)
            if (-not $NoGamePackage) {
                $game = Find-Game $exe
                $vortex = VortexOwner $game
                # Mods first: script mods left calling an ASI that isn't there fail the game's script compile.
                if (-not $vortex) {
                    $remove += @(@('Mods\modQuen', 'Mods\modQuenRpc', 'bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen.asi') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $game $_ } |
                        Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ })
                }
            }
            $remove | ForEach-Object { NeedsBin $_ }
            $path = UserPath
            $onPath = @($path -split ';' | Where-Object { IsBin $_ }).Count -gt 0
            $claude = Find-Claude
            Say 'uninstall:'
            if ($procs) { Write-Host "  stop: quen.exe (pid $($procs.Id -join ', '): your MCP clients' quen and its quen serve; no session is live)" }
            $remove | ForEach-Object { Show $_ }
            if ($vortex) { Write-Host "  stays: quen's in-game package in $game, which is Vortex's ($vortex): uninstall it in Vortex" }
            if ($onPath) { Write-Host "  out of your user PATH: $bin" }
            if ($claude) { Write-Host '  out of Claude Code: claude mcp remove --scope user quen' }
            if (-not (Ask 'Uninstall quen as listed?')) { Say 'nothing was changed'; return }
            if ($claude) {
                Change 'remove quen from Claude Code: claude mcp remove --scope user quen' {
                    Write-Host "  $((Run $claude mcp remove --scope user quen).out -join ' ')"
                }
            }
            if ($procs) { Stop-Quen $procs }
            foreach ($p in $remove) { Change "move $p to the Recycle Bin" { Recycle $p } }
            if ($onPath) {
                Change "take $bin out of your user PATH" { Set-UserPath (@($path -split ';' | Where-Object { -not (IsBin $_) }) -join ';') }
            }
            Say "$quenHome stays: your config, ledger, logs and captures. Move it to the Recycle Bin yourself once you no longer need them"
            return
        }

        $tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('quen-install-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('n'))
        [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($tmp)
        try {
            # The release: the folder -From names, else downloaded into the new temp folder.
            $want = @('quen-*-windows-x64.zip', 'SHA256SUMS.txt')
            if (-not $NoGamePackage) { $want += 'quen-w3-*.zip' }
            if ($WithRenderDoc) { $want += 'quen-streamline-dev-interposer-*.zip' }
            if ($From) { $dir = Full $From 'folder' } else {
                $dir = Join-Path $tmp 'release'
                [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($dir)
                $tag = if ($Version) { "v$Version" } else { $null }
                $which = if ($tag) { "release $tag" } else { 'latest release' }
                $api = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repo/releases/" + $(if ($tag) { "tags/$tag" } else { 'latest' })
                $release = $null
                try {
                    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 'Tls12'
                    $release = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri $api
                } catch { $https = $_.Exception.Message }
                if ($release) {
                    foreach ($asset in $release.assets) {
                        if (-not ($want | Where-Object { $asset.name -like $_ })) { continue }
                        Say "downloading $($asset.name)"
                        Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile (Join-Path $dir $asset.name)
                    }
                } else {
                    # A private repo answers an anonymous request with 404: then the user's own gh login.
                    if (-not (Get-Command gh -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
                        Refuse ("$Repo's $which isn't reachable over HTTPS ($https). While the repo is private, install the GitHub " +
                            'CLI (https://cli.github.com), run gh auth login with the account that has access to it, and run this again')
                    }
                    Say "$which not reachable over HTTPS ($https): downloading it with gh"
                    $ghArgs = @('release', 'download') + @($tag | Where-Object { $_ }) + @('--repo', $Repo, '--dir', $dir) +
                        @($want | ForEach-Object { '--pattern'; $_ })
                    $r = Run gh @ghArgs
                    if ($r.code) {
                        Refuse "gh release download: $($r.out -join ' '). Check that gh auth login was done with the account that has access to $Repo"
                    }
                }
            }
            $sumsPath = Join-Path $dir 'SHA256SUMS.txt'
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sumsPath -PathType Leaf)) { Refuse "no SHA256SUMS.txt in $dir" }
            $sums = @{}
            foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $sumsPath) {
                if ($line -match '^([0-9a-fA-F]{64}) [ *](.+)$') { $sums[$Matches[2]] = $Matches[1].ToLower() }
            }
            # Every zip this run uses is checked before any is opened.
            $assets = foreach ($pattern in $want | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'SHA256SUMS.txt' }) {
                $names = @($sums.Keys | Where-Object { $_ -like $pattern })
                if ($names.Count -ne 1) { Refuse "$sumsPath lists $($names.Count) files named like $pattern, not one" }
                $path = Join-Path $dir $names[0]
                if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { Refuse "$($names[0]) isn't in $dir" }
                if ((Sha $path) -ne $sums[$names[0]]) { Refuse "$path doesn't match SHA256SUMS.txt: a damaged or changed file" }
                $path
            }
            $quenZip = $assets | Where-Object { $_ -like '*-windows-x64.zip' }
            $w3Zip = $assets | Where-Object { (Split-Path -Leaf $_) -like 'quen-w3-*.zip' }
            $slZip = $assets | Where-Object { $_ -like '*streamline-dev-interposer-*' }
            $v = [regex]::Match((Split-Path -Leaf $quenZip), '^quen-(.+)-windows-x64\.zip$').Groups[1].Value
            if ($Version -and $v -ne $Version) { Refuse "$dir holds quen $v, not $Version" }

            $exeFile = ZipFiles $quenZip | Where-Object rel -eq 'quen.exe'
            if (-not $exeFile) { Refuse "$quenZip holds no quen.exe" }
            $newExe = Join-Path $tmp 'quen\quen.exe'
            Place $quenZip $exeFile $newExe
            $stamp = (Run $newExe --version).out -join ' '
            if ($stamp -notlike "quen $v *") { Refuse "the release's quen.exe says '$stamp', not quen $v" }
            Say "release: $stamp, from $dir"
            $doc = Idle $newExe

            # quen.exe: replaced only with -Update, stopped first if it runs.
            $hasExe = Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe
            $newQuen = -not $hasExe -or (Sha $exe) -ne $exeFile.sha
            if ($hasExe -and $newQuen -and -not $Update) {
                Refuse "quen is installed at $exe ($((Run $exe --version).out -join ' ')): run this again with -Update to replace it"
            }
            if ($hasExe -and $newQuen) { NeedsBin $exe }
            $procs = if ($newQuen) { Running } else { @() }

            # The in-game package: placed whole after quen's old package files go to the Recycle Bin, unless it is Vortex's.
            $package = $false
            if ($w3Zip) {
                $game = Find-Game $newExe
                $vortex = VortexOwner $game
            }
            if ($vortex) {
                Say "quen's in-game package in $game is Vortex's ($vortex): update it in Vortex. This installer leaves it as it is"
            } elseif ($w3Zip) {
                $x64 = Join-Path $game 'bin\x64_dx12'
                $loader = (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$x64\dinput8.dll") -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$x64\winmm.dll")
                if (-not ((Test-Path -LiteralPath "$x64\WitcherNativeBridge.asi") -and $loader)) {
                    $how = ($doc.dependencies | Where-Object { $_.name -like 'Witcher Native Bridge*' }).how_to_get
                    Refuse ("the Witcher Native Bridge isn't in $x64 (WitcherNativeBridge.asi and its ASI loader, dinput8.dll or " +
                        "winmm.dll), and quen's package needs it. Install it yourself: $how")
                }
                $w3Files = @(ZipFiles $w3Zip)
                foreach ($f in $w3Files) {
                    if ($f.rel -notmatch '^(bin\\x64_dx12\\[^\\]+|Mods\\modQuen\\[^:]+)$' -or $f.rel -match '\\\.\.(\\|$)') {
                        Refuse "$w3Zip holds $($f.rel), outside quen's package layout"
                    }
                }
                $w3Name = (Split-Path -Leaf $w3Zip) -replace '^quen-w3-(.+)\.zip$', 'quen-w3 $1'
                $modFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $game 'Mods\modQuen') -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
                $inPlace = -not (Differs $w3Files $game) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $game 'Mods\modQuenRpc')) -and
                    $modFiles.Count -eq @($w3Files | Where-Object { $_.rel -like 'Mods\*' }).Count
                if ($inPlace) { Say "$w3Name is already in $game" } else {
                    # Whole mod folders, Mods first: an old modQuen's other files, or modQuenRpc, fail the game's script compile.
                    $old = @(@('Mods\modQuen', 'Mods\modQuenRpc') + @($w3Files | Where-Object { $_.rel -notlike 'Mods\*' } | ForEach-Object { $_.rel }) |
                        ForEach-Object { Join-Path $game $_ } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ })
                    $old | ForEach-Object { NeedsBin $_ }
                    $package = $true
                }
            }

            # quen's build of the Streamline dev interposer, for RenderDoc: replaced only with -Update.
            $sl = $false
            if ($slZip) {
                $slFiles = @(ZipFiles $slZip)
                if ($slFiles | Where-Object { $_.rel -match '[\\:]|\.\.' }) { Refuse "$slZip holds a file in a folder: its files go side by side" }
                $sl = [bool](Differs $slFiles $slDir)
                if ($sl -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $slDir)) {
                    if (-not $Update) { Refuse "$slDir holds another build: run this again with -Update to replace it" }
                    NeedsBin $slDir
                }
                if (-not $sl) { Say "$slDir already holds this build" }
            }

            $path = UserPath
            $addPath = -not @($path -split ';' | Where-Object { IsBin $_ }).Count
            $claude = Find-Claude

            # The questions, all before the first change.
            Ask-Stop $procs
            if ($package) {
                Say "$w3Name, into ${game}:"
                $old | ForEach-Object { Show $_ }
                $w3Files | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  place: $(Join-Path $game $_.rel)" }
                $package = Ask "Install quen's in-game package ($w3Name) as listed?"
            }
            $addPath = $addPath -and (Ask "Add $bin to your user PATH, so a terminal finds quen?")
            $register = $claude -and (Ask "Register quen in Claude Code for all your projects (claude mcp add --scope user quen -- $exe mcp)? It replaces a user-scope server named quen")
            # The desktop app's Claude Code needs no claude on PATH: its settings folder says it is used here.
            $settings = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.claude\settings.json'
            $hook = ($claude -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path $settings))) -and (Ask ("Add a hook to $settings that brings " +
                    "Claude Code's window to the front before its prompts for quen's calls, while the game is in front? It never answers them (INSTALL.md section 4)"))
            $hookText = if ($hook) { With-Hook $settings $exe }
            if ($hook -and -not $hookText) { Say "quen's hook is already in $settings" }

            try {
                if ($procs) { Stop-Quen $procs }
                if ($newQuen) {
                    if ($hasExe) { Change "move the old $exe to the Recycle Bin" { Recycle $exe } }
                    Change "place quen $v at $exe" { Place $quenZip $exeFile $exe }
                } else { Say "$exe is already quen $v" }
                if ($addPath) { Change "add $bin to your user PATH" { Set-UserPath ((@($path.TrimEnd(';')) + $bin | Where-Object { $_ }) -join ';') } }
                if ($register) {
                    Change "register quen in Claude Code: claude mcp add --scope user quen -- $exe mcp" {
                        [void](Run $claude mcp remove --scope user quen)  # a user-scope quen from before, if any
                        $r = Run $claude mcp add --scope user quen '--' $exe mcp
                        Write-Host "  $($r.out -join ' ')"
                        if ($r.code) { Say "claude mcp add failed (exit $($r.code)): register quen yourself (INSTALL.md section 4)" }
                    }
                }
                if ($hookText) {
                    Change "add quen's hook to $settings (the file backed up first)" {
                        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $settings) {
                            $backup = "$settings.quen-backup-$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss)"
                            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $settings -Destination $backup
                            Write-Host "  backed up to $backup"
                        } else { [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Split-Path $settings)) }
                        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($settings, $hookText, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
                    }
                }
                if ($package) {
                    foreach ($p in $old) { Change "move $p to the Recycle Bin" { Recycle $p } }
                    # The ASI first: the script mod is never there without it.
                    foreach ($f in $w3Files | Sort-Object { $_.rel -like 'Mods\*' }) {
                        Change "place $(Join-Path $game $f.rel)" { Place $w3Zip $f (Join-Path $game $f.rel) }
                    }
                }
                if ($sl) {
                    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $slDir) { Change "move the old $slDir to the Recycle Bin" { Recycle $slDir } }
                    foreach ($f in $slFiles) { Change "place $(Join-Path $slDir $f.rel)" { Place $slZip $f (Join-Path $slDir $f.rel) } }
                }
            } catch {
                if ($done.Count) {
                    Say 'done before that (what it replaced is in the Recycle Bin):'
                    $done | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }
                }
                throw
            }
            if ($slZip) { Say "quen's Streamline dev interposer is in ${slDir}: quen_setup will offer it for RenderDoc captures" }

            # What's still missing: quen installs none of it.
            $doc = QuenJson $(if ($dry) { $newExe } else { $exe }) doctor
            if (-not $doc) { Say 'quen doctor answered no JSON: run quen doctor in a terminal' }
            foreach ($required in $true, $false) {
                $missing = @($doc.dependencies | Where-Object { $_.status -ne 'found' -and [bool]$_.required -eq $required })
                if (-not $missing) { continue }
                Say ('quen doctor, ' + $(if ($required) { 'needed for every session' } else { 'optional, each for some tools' }) +
                    ': missing or the wrong version (install these yourself)')
                foreach ($d in $missing) {
                    Write-Host "  $($d.name): $($d.status)$(if ($d.note) { ", $($d.note)" })"
                    Write-Host "    get it: $($d.how_to_get)"
                }
            }
            $others = @(Get-Process quen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and $_.Path -ne $exe } | ForEach-Object { $_.Path } | Sort-Object -Unique)
            foreach ($o in $others) {
                Say ("quen.exe also runs from $o. While a quen serve from there runs for the same config, this install's quen " +
                    "can't connect to it (each end checks the other is the same quen.exe): close the MCP clients that use it")
            }
            if (-not $claude) { Say "Claude Code (claude) isn't on PATH. Once it is: claude mcp add --scope user quen -- `"$exe`" mcp" }
            $json = $exe.Replace('\', '\\')
            Say 'other MCP clients (INSTALL.md section 4):'
            Write-Host ('  VS Code, in mcp.json''s "servers": "quen": {{ "type": "stdio", "command": "{0}", "args": ["mcp"] }}' -f $json)
            Write-Host ('  Cursor, in %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\mcp.json''s "mcpServers": "quen": {{ "command": "{0}", "args": ["mcp"] }}' -f $json)
            Write-Host ('  Codex CLI: run "{0}" serve --stay in a terminal first, then Codex (INSTALL.md section 4)' -f $exe)
            Say 'next: ask your agent to run quen_setup, then quen_doctor'
        } finally {
            try { Recycle $tmp } catch { Say "the temp folder $tmp stays: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_.Exception.Message -ForegroundColor Red
        if ($_.Exception.Message -notlike 'install: refused*') { Write-Host $_.InvocationInfo.PositionMessage }
        # Run as a file, it ends with exit code 1; through iex, exit would close the user's PowerShell.
        if ($PSCommandPath) { exit 1 }
    }
}
```

`tools/release/release.ps1`:

```ps1
# Packs quen-mcp's HEAD into the tester release assets. Never publishes: no tag, no upload.
# Usage: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\release\release.ps1 -Version <x.y.z> -OutDir <dir> -StreamlineDll <path>
# Every check runs before OutDir is written: a refusal leaves it as it was (cargo's and pack.py's build output aside).
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Version,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$OutDir,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$StreamlineDll
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem

# The interposer build this release ships (tools/streamline): a new build is a new pin here.
$SlVersion = '2.14.1'
$SlSha256 = 'a0483eb3de9063731f0e85e4e9b0f38e9884a33651a53c7b1e07f1d7822b6e24'
# Streamline's 3rd-party-licenses.md at that tag. Not committed: an author's email in it trips the privacy scan.
$SlNoticeSha256 = 'cb251639994465f31d2178c16acedf1ff4f9cef1c370a09782ed36d4c86c1dca'

function Sha($path) { (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $path).Hash.ToLower() }
# Runs a program, its output to the console. Windows PowerShell turns a program's stderr (cargo's progress) into
# errors, which 'Stop' would throw on: hence the local Continue and the exit code check.
function Native {
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    $exe, $rest = $args
    & $exe @rest 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "release: $($args -join ' ') failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
}

$repo = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((git -C $PSScriptRoot rev-parse --show-toplevel))
# A worktree sits inside the main checkout: OutDir may be in neither.
$main = Split-Path ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath((git -C $repo rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)))
$out = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([IO.Path]::Combine((Get-Location).Path, $OutDir))
foreach ($root in $repo, $main) {
    if (($out.TrimEnd('\') + '\').StartsWith($root.TrimEnd('\') + '\', 'OrdinalIgnoreCase')) {
        throw "release: OutDir $out is inside the repo ($root): release output never goes in the source tree (AGENTS.md)"
    }
}
if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $out) -and (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $out -Force | Select-Object -First 1)) {
    throw "release: OutDir $out is not empty: give a new or empty folder"
}
if (git -C $repo status --porcelain) { throw "release: $repo has uncommitted changes: a release is built from a commit" }
$crate = [regex]::Match((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "$repo\crates\quen\Cargo.toml"), '(?m)^version = "([^"]+)"').Groups[1].Value
if ($crate -ne $Version) { throw "release: -Version $Version is not crates/quen's version ($crate)" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StreamlineDll -PathType Leaf)) { throw "release: no file at -StreamlineDll $StreamlineDll" }
if ((Sha $StreamlineDll) -ne $SlSha256) { throw "release: $StreamlineDll is not the pinned interposer build ($SlSha256)" }
if (-not $env:WNB_SDK) { throw "release: set WNB_SDK to the Witcher Native Bridge SDK folder (w3/README.md)" }
foreach ($v in 'JAVA_HOME', 'FLEX_HOME', 'REDKIT') {
    if (-not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v)) { throw "release: set $v for w3\hud.py, the HUD line's bundle (w3/README.md)" }
}
# Shipped files must not name this PC or its user: the user and machine names, and the hooks' deny-list.
# The hooks' order (.githooks/deny-scan): QUEN_DENY_LIST, then %USERPROFILE%\.quen, then the pre-move %APPDATA%\quen.
$denyList = if ($env:QUEN_DENY_LIST) { $env:QUEN_DENY_LIST }
    elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.quen\deny.txt") { "$env:USERPROFILE\.quen\deny.txt" }
    else { "$env:APPDATA\quen\deny.txt" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $denyList)) { throw "release: no deny-list at $denyList (AGENTS.md)" }
$needles = @($env:USERNAME, $env:COMPUTERNAME) + @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $denyList | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^\s*(#|$)' }) |
    ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() }
$licence = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $repo -File | Where-Object Name -Match '^(LICEN[CS]E|COPYING)'
if (-not $licence) { Write-Warning 'no licence file in the repo yet (the maintainer picks one): the quen zip ships without one' }
$notice = "$repo\target\dist\3rd-party-licenses.md"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $notice) | Out-Null
Native curl.exe -sSfL -o $notice "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/v$SlVersion/3rd-party-licenses.md"
if ((Sha $notice) -ne $SlNoticeSha256) { throw "release: Streamline's 3rd-party-licenses.md isn't v$SlVersion's ($SlNoticeSha256)" }

$head = git -C $repo rev-parse --short=12 HEAD
# Panic messages carry source paths, which name the build machine: map them to neutral names. The encoded form keeps
# paths with spaces whole; its own target dir keeps these flags from rebuilding the everyday build.
$cargoHome = if ($env:CARGO_HOME) { $env:CARGO_HOME } else { "$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo" }
$env:CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS = @("--remap-path-prefix=$env:USERPROFILE=~", "--remap-path-prefix=$cargoHome=cargo",
    "--remap-path-prefix=$repo=quen") -join [char]0x1f
try { Native cargo build --release --locked -p quen --target-dir "$repo\target\dist" }
finally { Remove-Item Env:CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS }
$exe = "$repo\target\dist\release\quen.exe"
$stamp = & $exe --version
if ($stamp -ne "quen $Version ($head)") { throw "release: quen --version says '$stamp', not 'quen $Version ($head)'" }

# The Rust libraries built into quen.exe: every non-dev dependency of the quen crate in Cargo.lock, for Windows, each
# with its licence expression and its packaged licence files' text. THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, beside quen.exe.
$thirdParty = "$repo\target\dist\THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt"
$json = & cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --manifest-path "$repo\Cargo.toml" --filter-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'release: cargo metadata failed' }
$meta = ($json -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json
$byId = @{}; foreach ($p in $meta.packages) { $byId[$p.id] = $p }
$nodes = @{}; foreach ($n in $meta.resolve.nodes) { $nodes[$n.id] = $n }
$seen = @{}
$todo = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
$todo.Enqueue(($meta.packages | Where-Object name -eq 'quen').id)
while ($todo.Count) {
    foreach ($d in $nodes[$todo.Dequeue()].deps) {
        if (-not $seen[$d.pkg] -and ($d.dep_kinds | Where-Object { $_.kind -ne 'dev' })) { $seen[$d.pkg] = $true; $todo.Enqueue($d.pkg) }
    }
}
$crates = @($seen.Keys | Where-Object { $_ -notin $meta.workspace_members } | ForEach-Object { $byId[$_] } |
    Sort-Object name, version)
$sb = [Text.StringBuilder]::new()
[void]$sb.AppendLine("Third-party notices for quen $Version ($head)").AppendLine()
[void]$sb.AppendLine('quen itself is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE). quen.exe also contains the Rust')
[void]$sb.AppendLine('standard library (MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/rust-lang/rust) and the libraries below, each under its')
[void]$sb.AppendLine("own licence: $($crates.Count) crates, with the licence files each one ships.").AppendLine()
foreach ($p in $crates) {
    [void]$sb.AppendLine(('=' * 100)).AppendLine("$($p.name) $($p.version): $($p.license)")
    $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Split-Path -LiteralPath $p.manifest_path) -File |
        Where-Object Name -Match '^(LICEN[CS]E|COPYING|NOTICE|COPYRIGHT|UNLICENSE)' | Sort-Object Name)
    if (-not $files) { [void]$sb.AppendLine("(the crate ships no licence file; its licence: $($p.license))").AppendLine() }
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        [void]$sb.AppendLine(('-' * 40) + " $($f.Name)").AppendLine([IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName).TrimEnd()).AppendLine()
    }
}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($thirdParty, $sb.ToString(), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))

Native python -I "$repo\w3\pack.py"
# The release W3Quen.cpp names (kVersion), as pack.py reads it.
$w3Version = [regex]::Match((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "$repo\w3\asi\W3Quen.cpp"), 'kVersion\[\] = "([0-9.]+)"').Groups[1].Value
if (-not $w3Version) { throw "release: no kVersion in w3\asi\W3Quen.cpp" }
$w3Zip = "$repo\w3\out\quen-w3-$w3Version.zip"
# Both files must be the build the doctor accepts as this version, or testers' doctors would call it the wrong one.
$pinned = [regex]::Matches((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "$repo\crates\quen\src\doctor.rs"),
    'version: "quen-w3 ' + [regex]::Escape($w3Version) + '",\s*sha256: "([0-9a-f]{64})"') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }
$zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($w3Zip)
try {
    # The four pinned files (W3Quen.asi, quen.ws and, from 0.1.16, the HUD line's blob0.bundle and metadata.store); the
    # zip also holds W3Quen-licences.txt (from 0.1.3) and modQuen's README.txt (from 0.1.16), which the doctor doesn't pin.
    $built = foreach ($entry in $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '\.(asi|ws|bundle|store)$' }) {
        $s = $entry.Open()
        try { (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -InputStream $s).Hash.ToLower() } finally { $s.Dispose() }
    }
} finally { $zip.Dispose() }
if (@($pinned).Count -ne 4 -or @($built).Count -ne 4 -or ($built | Where-Object { $_ -notin $pinned })) {
    throw "release: quen-w3 $w3Version's files ($built) are not the doctor's pins ($pinned, crates/quen/src/doctor.rs)"
}

$quenZip = "quen-$Version-windows-x64.zip"
$slZip = "quen-streamline-dev-interposer-$SlVersion.zip"
$packs = [ordered]@{  # zip: [ordered] name in the zip -> source file
    $quenZip = [ordered]@{ 'quen.exe' = $exe; 'README.md' = "$repo\README.md"; 'INSTALL.md' = "$repo\INSTALL.md";
        'SECURITY.md' = "$repo\SECURITY.md" }
    $slZip = [ordered]@{ 'sl.interposer.dll' = $StreamlineDll; 'license.txt' = "$repo\tools\streamline\LICENSE-Streamline.txt"
        '3rd-party-licenses.md' = $notice; 'README.md' = "$PSScriptRoot\streamline-README.md" }
}
foreach ($l in $licence) { $packs[$quenZip][$l.Name] = $l.FullName }
$packs[$quenZip]['THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt'] = $thirdParty
# pack.py stores quen-w3's files uncompressed, so its zip is scanned whole. Text as UTF-8 and UTF-16 at both alignments.
# ponytail: reads each file whole; fine at these sizes (a few MB).
$leaks = foreach ($file in @($packs.Values | ForEach-Object { $_.Values }) + $w3Zip + "$PSScriptRoot\install.ps1") {
    $b = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file)
    $views = @([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($b), [Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString($b),
        [Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString($b, 1, $b.Length - 1)) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToLowerInvariant() }
    $hits = @($needles | Where-Object { $n = $_; $views | Where-Object { $_.Contains($n) } }).Count
    if ($hits) { "$file ($hits of the names)" }
}
if ($leaks) { throw "release: personal data (user or machine name, deny-list) in: $($leaks -join '; '). Nothing was packed." }

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
foreach ($name in $packs.Keys) {
    $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open("$out\$name", 'Create')
    try {
        foreach ($entry in $packs[$name].GetEnumerator()) {
            [void][IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($zip, $entry.Value, $entry.Key, 'Optimal')
        }
    } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
}
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $w3Zip, "$PSScriptRoot\install.ps1" -Destination $out
$assets = $quenZip, (Split-Path -Leaf $w3Zip), $slZip, 'install.ps1'
$sums = foreach ($name in $assets) { "$(Sha "$out\$name")  $name" }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$out\SHA256SUMS.txt", ($sums -join "`n") + "`n")

# git prints UTF-8; Windows PowerShell would read it in the console's code page.
$tag = git -C $repo tag --merged HEAD --sort=-creatordate | Select-Object -First 1
$encoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8
$log = git -C $repo log --first-parent --format=%s $(if ($tag) { "$tag..HEAD" } else { 'HEAD' })
[Console]::OutputEncoding = $encoding
$changes = $log | ForEach-Object { '- ' + ($_ -replace '^Merge (claude/\S+: )?', '') }
$since = if ($tag) { "Changes since $tag." } else { 'The first tester release.' }
$notes = @"
<!-- Draft by tools/release/release.ps1 from git log: rewrite the changes in plain words for testers before publishing. -->
# quen $Version

$since Built from commit ${head}: ``quen --version`` prints ``$stamp``. Paste that into bug reports.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| ``$quenZip`` | quen itself: ``quen.exe``, README, INSTALL and SECURITY. Start with INSTALL.md. |
| ``$(Split-Path -Leaf $w3Zip)`` | quen's in-game package for The Witcher 3 (``W3Quen.asi``, the licences of the code compiled into it, and the modQuen script). Its folders mirror the game folder: unzip it there. |
| ``$slZip`` | Optional, for RenderDoc captures only: a build of NVIDIA Streamline $SlVersion's interposer that RenderDoc can see. Not made or endorsed by NVIDIA. See its README. |
| ``install.ps1`` | The installer (INSTALL.md, Quick install): it downloads the latest release, or the one ``-Version`` names, checks it against its ``SHA256SUMS.txt``, and installs quen and its in-game package. |
| ``SHA256SUMS.txt`` | The sha256 of each zip and of ``install.ps1``. In PowerShell: ``Get-FileHash <file>``, and compare. |

## Changes

$($changes -join "`n")
"@
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$out\RELEASE-NOTES.md", $notes.Replace("`r`n", "`n"))

Write-Host "release: $out"
$sums | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }

```

`tools/release/streamline-README.md`:

```md
# quen's Streamline dev interposer (2.14.1)

`sl.interposer.dll` is a build of the interposer from NVIDIA Streamline 2.14.1, made by quen's maintainers from NVIDIA's public source (https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline, tag `v2.14.1`) with one patch, `tools/streamline/getprocaddress.patch` in quen-mcp. It's a non-production (Develop) build, and unsigned.

**NVIDIA neither made nor endorses this build.** Streamline is © NVIDIA Corporation under the MIT licence (`license.txt`); the notices for the third-party parts it uses are in `3rd-party-licenses.md`.

## What it's for

The Witcher 3 (5.01) loads D3D12 and DXGI through Streamline's interposer, which finds the real functions in a way RenderDoc's hooks never see, so RenderDoc can't capture the game. The patch makes this build look them up through `GetProcAddress`, which RenderDoc hooks.

## How quen uses it

Only quen's `renderdoc:NAME` launch profile uses it:

1. Keep the DLL anywhere outside the game folder.
2. Set `streamline_dev_interposer` to its path in quen's config (`quen setup`, see INSTALL.md), and `renderdoc` to your `renderdoccmd.exe`. `quen doctor` checks both.
3. For a renderdoc launch, quen swaps this build in for the game's signed one, journaled, with an `sl.interposer.json` beside it that keeps Streamline's own proxies out of the way. The session's end (or `session_recover` after a crash) puts NVIDIA's original back, checked by sha256 and Authenticode.

Never copy it into the game folder yourself.

To build it yourself instead, follow `tools/streamline/README.md` in quen-mcp.

```

`tools/streamline/README.md`:

```md
# A Streamline interposer RenderDoc can see

Witcher 3 (5.01) imports D3D12 and DXGI from NVIDIA Streamline's `sl.interposer.dll`. The interposer finds the real `d3d12.dll` and `dxgi.dll` functions by walking their export tables, so RenderDoc's hooks never see those calls and RenderDoc can't capture the game.

`getprocaddress.patch` makes a non-production build resolve each export through `GetProcAddress` instead, which RenderDoc hooks. With `sl.interposer.json` (`{"enableInterposer": false}`, read only by non-production builds) beside it, Streamline's own proxies stay out of the way too. quen's `renderdoc:NAME` launch profile swaps this build in for the game's signed one, journaled, and puts NVIDIA's file back afterwards, checked by sha256 and Authenticode.

Get it one of two ways. The repo never holds the DLL.

**Download quen's build:** `quen-streamline-dev-interposer-2.14.1.zip` from quen-mcp's GitHub Releases. It holds `sl.interposer.dll` (Streamline v2.14.1 with `getprocaddress.patch`, built with `build.bat -develop`), Streamline's `license.txt` and its `3rd-party-licenses.md`. Unzip it outside the game folder. The DLL's sha256 is `a0483eb3de9063731f0e85e4e9b0f38e9884a33651a53c7b1e07f1d7822b6e24`: `quen doctor` checks it and says "quen's release build". The build is quen's, not NVIDIA's: NVIDIA neither made nor endorses it.

**Or build it yourself**, once:

1. Get NVIDIA Streamline 2.14.1, the version the game ships, into a folder outside your user profile (the build embeds its source paths, which would name you): `git clone --branch v2.14.1 https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline C:\src\Streamline`.
2. Apply the patch in the clone: `git apply <quen-mcp>\tools\streamline\getprocaddress.patch`. It changes only `source\core\sl.interposer\hook.cpp`, and only in non-production builds (`#ifndef SL_PRODUCTION`).
3. Run `setup.bat vs2022` (it fetches the build dependencies into `C:\packman-repo` and makes the Visual Studio project), then `build.bat -develop`. Streamline's README lists what the build needs.
4. The DLL is `_artifacts\sl.interposer\Develop_x64\sl.interposer.dll`. It's unsigned, which is expected. Your build's sha256 differs from the release's unless your folder and compiler match; the doctor then says "built locally".
5. In quen's config, set `streamline_dev_interposer` to that file (or to the downloaded one) and `renderdoc` to your `renderdoccmd.exe`. `quen doctor` checks both, and checks that the game's own interposer is NVIDIA's signed original.

Never copy the dev build into the game folder yourself: quen's launch does it, and its end (or `session_recover` after a crash) puts the signed original back.

Streamline is © NVIDIA Corporation under the MIT licence; its notice is in `LICENSE-Streamline.txt`, which covers the patch too. The notices for the third-party parts Streamline uses are its `3rd-party-licenses.md`, in every clone. The release zip ships that file as fetched from the v2.14.1 tag, checked by sha256; it isn't committed here, because an author's email in it trips quen's privacy scan.

```

`tools/streamline/getprocaddress.patch`:

```patch
diff --git a/source/core/sl.interposer/hook.cpp b/source/core/sl.interposer/hook.cpp
index 172dee4..9352b46 100644
--- a/source/core/sl.interposer/hook.cpp
+++ b/source/core/sl.interposer/hook.cpp
@@ -156,6 +156,10 @@ if (config.contains(#a))
             f.name = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(dllBase + reinterpret_cast<const DWORD*>(dllBase + exportDir->AddressOfNames)[i]);
             auto ordinal = exportBase + reinterpret_cast<const  WORD*>(dllBase + exportDir->AddressOfNameOrdinals)[i];
             f.target = const_cast<void*>(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(dllBase + reinterpret_cast<const DWORD*>(dllBase + exportDir->AddressOfFunctions)[ordinal - exportBase]));
+#ifndef SL_PRODUCTION
+            // renodx local patch: resolve through GetProcAddress so capture tools (RenderDoc) that hook it see D3D12/DXGI calls.
+            if (auto p = GetProcAddress(handle, f.name)) f.target = reinterpret_cast<void*>(p);
+#endif
         }
         return true;
     }
```

`w3/README.md`:

```md
# quen's Witcher 3 package: `W3Quen.asi` + `modQuen`

quen's only game-side part for The Witcher 3 (5.01, DX12): one native ASI and one script mod, always installed together. It gives quen thirteen things:
- **Game state:** seven on/off values (gameplay, scene, cutscene, photo mode, fade or loading, dialogue, a menu open), written to `W3QuenState.log` next to `witcher3.exe`.
- **A command channel:** typed commands from quen over a named pipe, run by the script on the game's tick, with replies.
- **Camera paths:** a whole camera path from quen, played on the photo-mode camera with one set per game tick, in real time or frame by frame.
- **Console commands** to load a save by name, which quen types only when the command channel isn't up.
- **Tracy instrumentation** (from 0.1.3), only in quen's `tracy` launches: Tracy zones on 75 engine functions, ported from the W3Trace ASI (section Tracy, below). In any other launch none of it runs.
- **A new manual save** (from 0.1.4) on quen's `save` verb, as the game's menu writes one into its "Empty save slot".
- **An on-screen notice** (from 0.1.8) on quen's `notice` verb: quen's own short text, shown for 8 s; from 0.1.15 for the time quen gives (quen's lasting status line), taken down on `notice.hide`, beside a game sound event on `sound`; from 0.1.16 the lasting line in a HUD movie of quen's own where the HUD is drawn (section HUD line).
- **Photo mode's own interface** (from 0.1.9): photo mode opened and closed by the game's own functions, and its weather, time, environment and grading set as its menu sets them, each read back (`photo.*` verbs).
- **Items** (from 0.1.10): an item added to the player's inventory by its name, as the console's `additem` adds one, equipped if asked, its count read back (`items.add`).
- **Nearby actors** (from 0.1.10): the alive actors near the player, nearest first, each one's position, heading, velocity, names and flags (`world.actors`, read only).
- **The scene** (from 0.1.13): what the rendered camera sees, the ground at points, rays and sphere sweeps, navmesh lanes (`scene.frame`, `scene.ground`, `scene.ray`, `nav.line`, read only), and the photo-mode camera's no-clip (`cam.noclip`).
- **Exec functions** (from 0.1.13): a global `exec function` called by name with its arguments, as the console runs one, without typing: the ASI calls the game's console executor (`exec`, section Exec).
- **The free camera** (from 0.1.17): the game's own developer free camera, outside photo mode, with the world running: turned on or off, moved, and its state read (`freecam`, `freecam.set`, `freecam.get`).

Status 2026-10-19: 0.1.0 ran in live boot 2 (the natives registered, the state matched the W3 Game State Bridge's at gameplay, but photo mode never showed). 0.1.1 fixed photo mode and ran from live boot 3. 0.1.2 adds the camera paths (`cam.path`, `cam.frame`, `cam.stop` and the native `QUEN_CamAt`); it is built and tested offline (below), not yet run in the game. 0.1.3 adds the Tracy instrumentation; it too is built and tested offline only. Its `quen.ws` is 0.1.2's, byte for byte. 0.1.4 (2026-10-19) adds the `save` verb to both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.5 (2026-10-19) adds the read-only `world.get` verb to both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.5 ran in the game in feature tests 4 (2026-10-19): Tracy, `save`, `world.get`. 0.1.6 (2026-10-19) adds the menu bit (2048) to the state, and W3Quen.log's natives line names the release; built and tested offline only, and never published. 0.1.7 (2026-10-19) supersedes it with the same behaviour: only comments and two reply texts (`cam.set` and `cam.path` outside photo mode) are reworded, in both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.8 (2026-10-19) adds the `notice` verb to both files (quen shows it when it hands the controls to the user); built and tested offline only. 0.1.9 (2026-10-19) adds the `photo.*` verbs, and rain, snow and the sky flag to `world.get`, in both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.10 (2026-10-19, rebuilt 2026-10-20 before its release) adds the `items.add` and `world.actors` verbs to both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.12 (2026-10-20) adds `world.actors`' `tag` and `class` and each entity's id and actor flag, in both files; built and tested offline only. 0.1.13 (2026-10-21) adds the scene reads and `cam.noclip` to both files and the exec verb to the ASI; built and tested offline only. 0.1.14 (2026-10-21) changes `scene.frame`'s box for an actor with a head bone to one around its body (finding 89), in `quen.ws`; its ASI differs from 0.1.13's only in its version; built and tested offline only. 0.1.15 (2026-10-21) adds `notice`'s `duration_ms` and the `notice.hide` and `sound` verbs to both files, for quen's lasting status line; built and tested offline only. 0.1.16 (2026-10-22) adds quen's own HUD movie for the lasting line (modQuen's new `content\blob0.bundle` and `metadata.store`, and `README.txt`) and its use by `notice` and `notice.hide` in `quen.ws`; its ASI differs from 0.1.15's only in its version; built and tested offline only. 0.1.17 (2026-10-23) adds the free-camera verbs (`freecam`, `freecam.set`, `freecam.get`) to both files; its bundle and store are 0.1.16's, byte for byte; built and tested offline only (the natives themselves ran in the free-camera probe's boot 237, `probes\freecam\`). 0.1.18 (2026-10-23) makes `scene.frame` project from the free camera while it is on (boot 238: `WorldVectorToViewRatio` still projected from the gameplay camera behind the player), in `quen.ws`; its ASI differs from 0.1.17's only in its version, its bundle and store are 0.1.16's, byte for byte; built and tested offline only.

The sources moved here from the maintainer's `witcher3-mods` repo (its `asi\quen` and `content\modQuen`, commit d74d3a5), where modQuenRpc was a separate script mod. It is now folded into modQuen.

## This folder

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `asi\W3Quen.cpp` | the ASI: registers `QUEN_Next`, `QUEN_Reply`, `QUEN_State` and `QUEN_CamAt` through the Witcher Native Bridge, writes the two logs, serves the pipe, checks and interpolates camera paths, calls the console executor for `exec` |
| `asi\trace.h`, `asi\hooks.inc` | the Tracy instrumentation, the functions it hooks (quen reads that list too), and the one the ASI calls (`W3_CALL`) |
| `asi\build.bat`, `asi\test.cpp`, `asi\wnb_stub.cpp` | build and offline test |
| `third_party\` | Tracy 0.14.1's client and Microsoft Detours 4.0.1, compiled into the ASI (versions and licences: its README) |
| `mod\modQuen\content\scripts\local\quen.ws` | the one script: state, channel, camera paths, photo mode, console commands |
| `mod\modQuen\README.txt` | the notice REDkit's licence asks of everything made with it, and what modQuen is |
| `hud\quen\QuenHud.as` | quen's HUD movie, ActionScript 3 only, no art (section HUD line) |
| `hud\extern\` | compile-time declarations of four Adobe easing classes the game's HUD classes import; never in a movie |
| `hud.py` | builds the HUD movie into modQuen's bundle (section HUD line) |
| `pack.py` | builds, tests and packs the release zip |
| `probes\walkers\` | a throwaway probe mod, never packed: do spawned NPCs walk where scripts tell them (its README) |
| `probes\indicator\` | a throwaway probe mod and its fallback, never packed: can the game's own notification and a revived HUD module carry quen's lasting status line (its README) |
| `probes\freecam\` | a throwaway probe mod, never packed: does the game's developer free camera work in the retail 5.01 with the world running (its README) |
| `out\` | build output and zips (ignored by git, never committed) |

## Release

- Releases are GitHub Release assets of this repo: `quen-w3-<version>.zip`, built by `pack.py`. Its root mirrors the game folder:
  ```
  bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen.asi
  bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen-licences.txt
  Mods\modQuen\content\scripts\local\quen.ws
  Mods\modQuen\content\blob0.bundle        (from 0.1.16)
  Mods\modQuen\content\metadata.store      (from 0.1.16)
  Mods\modQuen\README.txt                  (from 0.1.16)
  ```
- `W3Quen-licences.txt` (from 0.1.3) holds the notices of the code compiled into the ASI: Tracy's client (3-clause BSD) and the libraries inside it (moodycamel::ConcurrentQueue, SPSCQueue, LZ4), and Detours (MIT). Each licence asks for its notice to come with the binary.
- `README.txt` (from 0.1.16) starts with the notice REDkit's licence (`wcc_eula.rtf`) asks of anything made with it and distributed: the bundle is packed by its wcc_lite. The licence forbids selling what is made with it and gives CD PROJEKT RED a free licence to it; quen-w3 is free.
- Each release's notes give the sha256 of the pinned files and of the zip. quen's doctor pins `W3Quen.asi` and `quen.ws` exactly, so a half from another version is refused before a launch, and from 0.1.16 the bundle's two files of the ASI's release.
- The zip bundles neither the Native Bridge nor an ASI loader: a bundled copy could overwrite a newer one on patch day.

## Install (by hand, once per version)

- **Needs first:**
  - the public **Witcher Native Bridge 2.0** (Nexus mod 13743), including the ASI loader in its download (`dinput8.dll`; any Ultimate ASI Loader x64 named `dinput8.dll` or `winmm.dll` works);
  - the Microsoft VC++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime, which the Native Bridge needs. `W3Quen.asi` itself needs no runtime: it is built with the static CRT.
- **Install:** unpack the zip into `%GAME_DIR%` (the folder holding `bin\` and `Mods\`). Replace an older `Mods\modQuen`, and remove any `Mods\modQuenRpc`: its functions are now in modQuen, and two copies are a compile error.
- **The first launch recompiles the game's scripts** once (it takes longer). A script error shows a `witcher3.exe` dialog or closes the game.
- **Removal order:** `Mods\modQuen` first, then `bin\x64_dx12\W3Quen.asi` (and `W3Quen-licences.txt`). The script imports the ASI's natives, so a script without its ASI stops the script compile at boot.
- **Never install anything from `out\test`:** its `WitcherNativeBridge.asi` is the test stand-in and would break every native mod.
- **Outside quen sessions it is quiet:** without quen's launch token the ASI writes no file, opens no pipe, and `QUEN_Next` always returns "". The script still polls the state about 4 times a second and calls one native per frame.
- **Outside quen's tracy launches the Tracy part is dormant:** no hook, no thread, no socket, no allocation (section Tracy).

## Game state

- `CR4Game.OnTick` polls at most 4 times a second, timed by `GetLocalTimeAsMilliseconds()`, and calls `QUEN_State(flags)` only when the flags change. 0.1.0 timed it by `GetEngineTimeAsSeconds()`, which likely stands still in photo mode: live boot 2's state log never showed photo mode (128).
- It also polls at once when a game starts (`OnGameStarted`, `OnAfterLoadingScreenGameStart`: live boot 2's first state came 0.33 s after the W3 Game State Bridge's, which polls there) and when the photo-mode menu opens or closes (`CR4PhotomodeMenu.OnMenuShown` / `OnClosingMenu`; photo mode switches on before the menu opens and off before it closes).
- An `OnGameEnded` wrap sends 0 at once. That is the "a load began" signal: the tick doesn't run through a load's loading screen (live boot 1 saw 17-18 s without any state).
- The flags use the W3 Game State Bridge's numbers, so quen's `bridge_log` parser reads both logs; 2048 is quen's own. The values come from the same vanilla script calls, written fresh under quen's own names:

  | Value | Meaning | Vanilla call |
  |---|---|---|
  | 0 | no player: main menu, or between saves | `thePlayer` is null |
  | 1 | valid (a game session runs) | `thePlayer` is set |
  | 16 | a non-gameplay scene plays | `theGame.IsCurrentlyPlayingNonGameplayScene()` |
  | 32 | the player is in a non-gameplay cutscene | `thePlayer.IsInNonGameplayCutscene()` |
  | 128 | photo mode | `theGame.GetPhotomodeEnabled()` |
  | 256 | blackscreen, fading or the loading video | `theGame.IsBlackscreenOrFading()`, `IsLoadingScreenVideoPlaying()` |
  | 512 | dialogue or cutscene script flag (can go stale) | `theGame.IsDialogOrCutscenePlaying()` |
  | 2048 | a menu is open: the pause menu the game opens when it loses the front, among others (from 0.1.6; W3GSB has no such bit) | `theGame.GetGuiManager().IsAnyMenu()`, the check vanilla makes before photo mode and the pause menu open |

- **`W3QuenState.log`** (next to `witcher3.exe`, written only when quen launched the game): one line per change, `<tick> push=<n> flags=<f>`, where the tick is `GetTickCount64` in ms. That's the W3 Game State Bridge's line form.
- **`W3Quen.log`** names the release on its natives line (from 0.1.6): `W3Quen 0.1.7: natives queued=1 (WNB API <n>)`. In a tracy launch the 75 hook lines and their total come before it (0.1.7, 2026-10-19). `pack.py` takes the zip's version from the same constant (`kVersion`), so each release's ASI differs from the last: quen's doctor tells a release by its ASI's sha256.
- **`W3Quen.log`** records how many `QUEN_Next` calls came before the first state, and the first call's tick: `first QUEN_State (flags F) after N QUEN_Next calls, the first at tick T`. More than 0 means the game tick runs before gameplay, at the main menu or during the first load; T against the launch and the main menu's time says which (live boot 2: about 2,670 calls in either boot).
- **Living beside the W3 Game State Bridge:** quen reads nothing it writes and reuses none of its names (every name here starts with `QUEN` or `quen`). Both mods wrap `CR4Game.OnTick`, `OnGameStarted`, `OnAfterLoadingScreenGameStart` and `OnGameEnded`, and `CR4PhotomodeMenu.OnMenuShown` and `OnClosingMenu`; every wrap here calls `wrappedMethod()` first and depends on no other mod's wraps.

## Command channel

### What quen must do at launch
- Put `W3_QUEN_TOKEN` (16-64 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`, new for every launch) and `W3_QUEN_PID` (quen's own pid, decimal) in the game's environment. The pipe is `\\.\pipe\quen-w3-<token>`.
- Connect as that pid. The ASI drops any other client (`GetNamedPipeClientProcessId`). Before sending, check that `GetNamedPipeServerProcessId` is the game's pid in quen's job.
- With a bad token or pid there is no pipe, and `W3Quen.log` says why.

### The pipe
- One instance, `FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE` (a name someone else created first is refused, never joined), `PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS`, and a DACL with one entry: the current user. Overlapped I/O on one worker thread; the game thread only touches two queues under a mutex.
- Wire format: JSON lines as in quen-core's `protocol.rs`. A request line holds at most 4,096 bytes, a reply line 65,536.
- The ASI checks every request as `decode_request` does: unknown verbs and fields, wrong types, duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, non-finite numbers, an empty name, hour past 23 and fov not above 0 are all refused; from 0.1.9 also a `photo.time` minute outside 0 to below 1440, a `photo.grade` or `photo.tick` without a value, a `photo.tick` time outside 0 to 10 s, and a `photo.list` filter that is empty or over 200 bytes; from 0.1.10 also an `items.add` name over 200 bytes or count outside 1 to 1000, and a `world.actors` radius not above 0 or over 100, or a max outside 1 to 50; from 0.1.12 also a `world.actors` `tag` or `class` other than 1 to 64 letters, digits and `_`; from 0.1.13 also a `scene.frame` radius not above 0 or over 100, a max outside 1 to 16, points outside 0 to 3, an `at` not 3 coordinates or an `entity_id` that isn't a whole number in int's range, a `scene.ground`, `scene.ray` or `nav.line` without 1 to 16 points or segments of coordinates below 100,000 in size, a range not above 0 or over 100, a radius over 10 (`scene.ray`'s over 2), a search over 50 or a width over 5, and an `exec` function other than 1 to 64 letters, digits and `_`, over 8 args, an arg over 100 bytes, with a quote or a byte outside printable ASCII, or a line over 512 bytes; from 0.1.17 also a `freecam.get` radius not above 0 or over 100. It also refuses a control character in a name, and a `settime` day above 2^31-1, the script's int range. A refusal is a reply with `"ok":false`, carrying the request's id, or id 0 if the id itself was unreadable.
- Each request's `ttl_ms` is checked when the script polls. An older command is answered `expired: waited N ms` and never runs.
- At most 16 commands wait. A disconnect drops what the client left queued.
- A command handed to the script that gets no `QUEN_Reply` (a script error) is answered `modQuen gave no reply` at the next poll.
- Reply `data`:
  - `listsaves`: an array of `SSavegameInfo.filename`;
  - `cam.get`, `cam.set`, `cam.path` and `cam.frame`: `{"camera":"photomode"|"game","pos":[x,y,z],"rot":[pitch,yaw,roll],"fov":f}`. `rot` is the scripts' `EulerAngles` order, in degrees, the same order the requests use. After a set it is the photo-mode camera's own read-back.
  - `world.get`: `{"player":{"pos":[x,y,z],"heading":heading},"time":{"day":day,"hour":hour},"rain":r,"snow":s,"sky_clear":b,"weather":"<name>"}`, from the script's `x y z heading day hour rain snow skyclear weather` (floats with 4 decimals; skyclear 0 or 1). `rain`, `snow` and `sky_clear` are from 0.1.9. Anything else, an hour past 23 included, is the read-back that did not parse.
  - `photo.list`: an array, as `listsaves`'s (from `a|b|c`).
  - `scene.frame` (from 0.1.13): `{"found":n,"camera":{"pos":[..],"rot":[..],"fov":f},"entities":[{"id":i,"name":..,"entity":..,"entity_cut":b,"player":b,"pos":[..],"heading":h,"head":[..] or null,"torso":[..] or null,"in_front":b,"x":x or null,"y":y or null,"share":s,"box_whole":b,"distance":d,"visible":{"head":b or null,"torso":b or null,"origin":b or null},"visible_points":n}]}`, from the script's `<found> <camera x y z pitch yaw roll fov>` then per entity `|<flags> <id> <x> <y> <share> <distance> <x y z> <heading> <head x y z> <torso x y z>|<name>|<entity>` (flags 1 centre in front, 2 the whole box in front, 4 the player, 8 a head bone, 16 a torso bone, 32 / 64 / 128 a clear ray to head / torso / origin, 256 / 512 / 1024 that ray cast, 2048 entity cut, 4096 `IsInView()`), `"in_view":b` after `in_front`. At most 16 entities.
  - `scene.ground`, `scene.ray` and `nav.line` (from 0.1.13): an array, one object per point or segment, from the script's `<n>` then per one `|<flags> <numbers>`: `{"nav_z":z or null,"ground":{"pos":[..],"normal":[..]} or null,"water_level":w,"water_depth":d,"free":b or null,"safe":[..] or null}` (12 numbers; flags 1 navmesh z, 2 a ground hit, 4 free, 8 the circle tested, 16 a safe spot), `{"hit":b,"pos":[..] or null,"normal":[..] or null,"distance":d or null}` (7; flag 1 a hit), `{"clear":b,"clear_in_direction":b,"reach":[..],"edge_m":e}` (4; flags 1 clear, 2 in direction).
  - `exec` (from 0.1.13): `{"line":"<the line called>","log":"<what the engine logged on its main thread during the call>"}`, also when nothing was called (section Exec).
  - `freecam`, `freecam.set` and `freecam.get` (from 0.1.17): `{"on":b,"paused":b,"pos":[..],"camera":{"pos":[..],"rot":[..]},"player":{"pos":[..],"heading":h},"radius":r,"near_camera":n,"near_player":n}`, from the script's `<on 0|1> <paused 0|1> <free camera x y z> <rendered camera x y z pitch yaw roll> <player x y z heading> <radius> <near camera> <near player>` (floats with 4 decimals; the counts whole numbers). Anything else is the read-back that did not parse.
  - `items.add` (from 0.1.10): `{"before":b,"after":a,"equipped":e}`, from the script's `<before> <after> <0|1>`: the item's count in the player's inventory before and after the add, and whether the first one added reads back as equipped. Anything else is the read-back that did not parse.
  - `world.actors` (from 0.1.10): `{"found":n,"actors":[{"name":..,"entity":..,"pos":[x,y,z],"heading":h,"velocity":[x,y,z] or null,"distance":d,"combat":b,"hostile":b,"guard":b,"at_work":b,"action_point":b,"scene":b,"entity_cut":b,"id":i,"actor":b}]}` (`entity_cut` from 0.1.11, `id` and `actor` from 0.1.12), from the script's `<found>` then per actor `|x y z heading vx vy vz distance flags id|<name>|<entity>` (flags 1 combat, 2 hostile, 4 guard, 8 at work, 16 action point, 32 scene, 64 velocity known, 128 entity cut, 256 not an actor; `velocity` null without 64; `id` a whole number in the script's int range; 0.1.11's nine numbers don't parse). Anything else, more actors than found included, is the read-back that did not parse.
  - `photo.get`, `photo.weather`, `photo.env`, `photo.time`, `photo.grade` and `photo.reset` (from 0.1.9): `{"weather":"<name>","minute":m,"env":"<path>","grading":{..},"grading_at_open":{..},"rain":r,"snow":s,"sky_clear":b,"world_weather":"<name>"}`, from the script's `<minute> <8 grading> <8 grading at open> <rain> <snow> <skyclear>|<weather>|<env path>|<world weather>`. `grading` and `grading_at_open` hold `exposure`, `contrast`, `highlights`, `saturation`, `temperature`, `vignette`, `grain` and `chromatic_aberration`. Anything else is the read-back that did not parse.

### Verbs
The script polls from `CR4Game.OnTick`. On 5.01 that tick runs about once per frame in gameplay, in photo mode, under `theGame.Pause` and `SetTimeScale(0)`, and behind the focus-loss pause menu (measured in the probe boot, below). Whether it runs at the main menu is open; commands sent while it doesn't run wait and expire.

Each call was checked in the game's own scripts (content0, 5.01). The "Probe boot" column says what an experiment boot (2026-10-17, before this package existed) ran in the game from a probe mod. The status above says which package versions have run in the game.
```
